From the Eagles 23rd Destroyer Squadron
<color=#ffde38>All Beavers, maintain 31 knots! Forward! -- Charles Ausburne</color>

105.describe: Hold your positions! Wait until the enemy fires! If the enemy forces us into war, then we'll meet them head on!

106.name: Iron Blood Medal
106.describe: An ancient medal recovered from the site of the final battle during Operation "Dichotomous Chess." After being recovered by the Naval HQ, these were awarded to commanders who made outstanding contributions in battle. You can almost feel the fanatical, indomitable will of the Iron Blood pulsing in this medal.

107.describe: A beautiful painting of Indianapolis. What a treasure!

117.name: Eagle Medal
117.describe:
After having been recovered by HQ from the burning ruins, it was given to the Commander who has made an outstanding contribution in Operation: Fallen Wings.
			<color=#ffde38>—— To commemorate those brave Eagles who fell for the cause of Azur Lane.</color>

118.describe: With hyperdimensional materials and technology, the medal was forged and polished to shine brightly in an unusual way. It is granted to those who dare to face the challenge from another dimension.

Nobody knows how it was made, or what materials it is made of, and it gives off an aura just as imposing as the original. Awarded to Commanders who displayed excellence during the "Violet Tempest, Blooming Lycoris" event.

Awarded to Commanders who displayed excellence during the "Parallel Superimposition" event.

Its tones soar, just as the elegant apsaras who plucks its strings.n



<color=#fcae33>Can be used to play music.</color>

A keepsake of your faithful encounter and a promise that you'd meet again.

A scroll depicting the stunning view of the stormy Akashi Castle.

Now you can have the Demon King's castle in your own home! ...Does any adventurer out there even want a trophy like this?

Gone are the people, and all that remains is this scene. Memories form this gap in Naraka.

27123.name: Shower Room
27123.describe: Don't be a dork; shower before going into the pool.

27124.name: Shark Slide
27124.describe: People willingly climbing into the jaws of a shark only to be spit out! What a sight!

27126.name: Unrestricted Pool Area
27126.describe: It's a free-for-all! Come on in whether you have a swim ring or not!

27201.name: Naval Beer
27201.describe: Respect the beer. It deserves its own swim ring as much as anybody else.

27202.name: Frozen Watermelon
27202.describe: Can't let summer pass without having some of this.

27301.name: Window with Curtains
27301.describe: Is what lies beyond the real deal, or just part of the wallpaper? Only one way to find out.

28001.name: Forest Wallpaper
28001.describe: Smells like pine trees and fresh air.

28002.name: Forest Flooring
28002.describe: Who knows? Maybe you can plant something here?

28102.name: Forest Big Bush
28102.describe: Don't get your hopes up. It's not big enough to hide in.

28103.name: Floral Bed
28103.describe: Any forest pygmy would be happy to sleep here.

28104.name: Small Vegetable Field 1
28104.describe: You can't get more locally sourced than this.

28105.name: Small Vegetable Field 2
28105.describe: You can't get more locally sourced than this.

28106.name: Bent Tree Lamp
28106.describe: But how does it produce light...?

28107.name: Orange Flower
28107.describe: A sturdy, colorful chair inspired by nature.

28108.name: Pink Flower
28108.describe: A sturdy, colorful chair inspired by nature.

28109.name: White Flower
28109.describe: A sturdy, colorful chair inspired by nature.

28110.name: Mushroom Chair
28110.describe: You feel like it should be softer.

28111.name: Carrot Mat
28111.describe: Picky eaters, leave your attitude at the door.

28112.name: Lawn Carpet
28112.describe: Finally, one can touch grass without leaving the house.

28115.name: Forest Nightstand
28115.describe: The ideal place to leave your glasses, or a cup of water, or a book.

28116.name: Forest Banner
28116.describe: A sheet between two poles can aesthetically contribute a lot.

28117.name: Stone Flowerbed
28117.describe: Given some soil and water, plants truly can grow anywhere.

28118.name: Pastoral Manjuu
28118.describe: The friendly and generous owner. Be sure to return their kindness!

28119.name: Fruit Basket
28119.describe: If only real fruits were this big.

28121.name: Wise Owl
28121.describe: It appears that the time has finally come for you to start your adventure!

28122.name: Wooden Floor
28122.describe: As much as you love nature, you'd rather not walk on dirt all day.

28123.name: Wooden Hut
28123.describe: A cute little hut to play games in with your friends.

28124.name: Vine Swing
28124.describe: Should not be used by adults – the vines would snap.

28125.name: Hollow Log Chair
28125.describe: A microcosm of the circle of life. More pragmatically, you can sit on it.

28126.name: Watering Can
28126.describe: It is to thirsty plants what a mother bird is to its young.

28127.name: Tree Stump
28127.describe: Oh, how the might-tree have fallen...

28128.name: Log Fence
28128.describe: Of little use on account of how short it is.

28129.name: One-Person Hot Spring
28129.describe: Just big enough to fit one person. Mind the slippery stones.

28130.name: Two-Person Hot Spring
28130.describe: Still small, but there's room for two people. Don't get any funny ideas!

28131.name: Forest Table
28131.describe: That must have been one massive tree they got it from.

28132.name: Wooden Table
28132.describe: You've never seen a tree with THAT shape before.

28133.name: Cave Entrance
28133.describe: Look! It's an honest-to-god wild manjuu!

28134.name: Molejuu
28134.describe: Don't get the hammer out. Leave the poor guy alone.

28201.name: Strawberry Juice
28201.describe: Could use a bit of milk, but it's not bad on its own.

28203.name: Morning Coffee
28203.describe: Don't we all need a cup of bean juice in the morning?

28204.name: Picnic Basket
28204.describe: There are sandwiches, bread, jam, and more. Help yourself.

28206.name: Cheesecake
28206.describe: Dangerously high in calories. Proceed with caution.

28301.name: Slit Window
28301.describe: You need a chair to stand on to have any hope of seeing through it.

28303.name: Cabin Loft
28303.describe: Somewhere between the first and bottom floors. Floor B.5?

28304.name: Forest Candle
28304.describe: Let's be honest, this is a serious fire hazard.

28305.name: Wooden Door
28305.describe: Be polite – knock before you enter.

28306.name: Wooden Wall
28306.describe: The partition between nature and in-touch-with-nature.

28307.name: Wooden Clock
28307.describe: Even the internal components are made of wood!

29001.name: Deep Sea Wallpaper
29001.describe: Who said the ocean wasn't brimming with color?

29002.name: Deep Sea Flooring
29002.describe: This isn't the ocean floor. Deeper below, the sun's rays can't even reach.

29101.name: Clam Bed
29101.describe: The pearl acts as a cushion.

29102.name: Jellyfish Bed
29102.describe: As soft as the real deal with none of the toxins.

29103.name: Sea Shell Bed
29103.describe: You won't find this shell sold by the seashore.

29104.name: Clam Chair
29104.describe: A large clam shell that's been smoothed out, cushioned, and given a leg.

29105.name: Starfish Carpet
29105.describe: Your gut tells you its name is Patrick.

29106.name: Sand Carpet
29106.describe: It's rough, it's coarse, but unlike regular sand, it doesn't get everywhere.

29107.name: Pearl Curtain
29107.describe: The name sounds like a euphemism. We're not sure for what.

29108.name: Sea Anemone
29108.describe: While creepy to some, it's perfectly harmless. You can even go inside it.

29109.name: Glowing Sea Shell
29109.describe: This must be a key item.

29110.name: Seahorse
29110.describe: The only kind of horse you can ride unwater.

29111.name: Hydrothermal Vent
29111.describe: Essentially an underwater volcano. As dangerous as it sounds.

29114.name: Bubble Bath
29114.describe: Not the kind you were expecting, is it?

29115.name: Decorative Bubble
29115.describe: Full of aquatic life that calls the sea floor their home.

29116.name: Shell Couch
29116.describe: Contains 0% actual shells. That would be awful to sit on.

29117.name: Deep Sea Coral
29117.describe: One of the most beautiful and, tragically, endangered organisms in the sea.

29118.name: Deep Sea Crag
29118.describe: A common hangout spot for small fish, eels, and the like.

29119.name: Coral Table
29119.describe: Made from a combination of coral and stone.

29120.name: Boulder Table
29120.describe: An unusually flat boulder that's suitable as a table.

29122.name: Deep Sea Bathtub
29122.describe: Of questionable use, since you're already surrounded by water.

29201.name: Edible Conch
29201.describe: It's like escargot of the sea.

30001.name: Rainbow Wallpaper
30001.describe: Depending on who you ask, it adds just enough or way too much color to the room.

30002.name: Colorful Flooring
30002.describe: They say all the best things in life come in the shape of tiles.

30101.name: Rainbow Snow Cone
30101.describe: It gets sweeter as you make your way through it.

30103.name: Swirly Road
30103.describe: A legendary road, rumored to be very hard for go-karts to stay on.

30104.name: Flower Cushion
30104.describe: Smells flowery! Might just be the detergent they use.

30105.name: Heart Cushion
30105.describe: Few can resist trying to align their butt perfectly with the outline of the heart.

30106.name: Jelly Cushion
30106.describe: Bouncier and more colorful than its cousin, the pudding cushion.

30107.name: Doughnut Cushion
30107.describe: What intricate glazing. Too bad it's not edible.

30108.name: Paint Splatter Carpet
30108.describe: It's long since dried, so it's safe to walk on.

30109.name: Rainbow Carpet
30109.describe: All that's missing is Akashi and a giant, frosted pastry.

30110.name: Gumball Jar
30110.describe: There's just something amazing about gumballs. Can't quite put my finger on what.

30111.name: Rainbow Arch
30111.describe: Want to make a flashy entrance? Now's your chance.

30113.name: Blue Puffy Marshmallow
30113.describe: So fluffy it almost feels like cotton candy.

30114.name: Green Puffy Marshmallow
30114.describe: "Tastes like... lime... No wait, pear... Maybe it's green apple..."

30115.name: Pink Puffy Marshmallow
30115.describe: Pink, as we all know, is the cutest color. Therefore, this is the cutest marshmallow.

30116.name: Pretty Balloons
30116.describe: They may be surplus from an amusement park, but they feel right at home.

30117.name: Swirly-Whirly Jr. & Sr.
30117.describe: A certain Iron Blood submarine will do almost anything for one of these.

30118.name: Rainbow Lacquer Bathtub
30118.describe: Has anyone else noticed how lacquer and baths go together like bread and butter?

30119.name: Painting Table
30119.describe: It's less of a painting table and more of a painted table, but it serves the same purpose in the end.

30120.name: Cake Slice Table
30120.describe: More proof that you can have your cake... but not eat it.

30121.name: Rainbow Castle
30121.describe: Fits three people. The magic number!

30123.name: Fluffy Cloud
30123.describe: Takes you to cloud nine and back! ... What do you mean you're not interested?

30124.name: Rainbow Surprise 1
30124.describe: What's inside? It's a surprise, so only one way to find out.

30201.name: Small Fluffy Marshmallow
30201.describe: It may be small, but it's every bit as yummy as the others.

30202.name: Vegetable Salad
30202.describe: Cesare didn't make it, yet she's proud of it for some reason.

30301.name: Rainbow Window
30301.describe: "Hurry, get your coat! We've got a pot of gold to find!"

30302.name: Weather Mobile
30302.describe: An educational piece that shows destroyers how rainbows are formed.

30303.name: Rainbow Clock
30303.describe: What time is it? It's a quarter to lavender.

31101.name: Battoriship
31101.describe: Here to protect the peace of Atré Akihabara! And the port too, I guess!

31102.name: Waittoriess
31102.describe: She's actually a maid, but let's not split hairs. What matters is that she's wise and reliable.

31103.name: 7-Stori Building
31103.describe: Where Atré is. It's right above Akihabara Station; you can't miss it!

31104.name: Coo-coo Train
31104.describe: Choo-choo, coo-coo! All aboard the train to Atré Akihabara!

33001.name: Festival Wallpaper
33001.describe: The beauty of fireworks on a summer evening won't be around all year long, but this wallpaper will.

33002.name: Festival Flooring
33002.describe: Produces just the most satisfying clack sound when you walk over it with wooden shoes.

33102.name: Chair w/ Folding Screen
33102.describe: Projects elegance from the front, protects against grabs from the back.

33103.name: Festival Mochi
33103.describe: It's a like a sweet, tangy little snowman that doesn't melt! Delicious!

33104.name: Goldfish Scooping Stall
33104.describe: A festival-goer favorite. If you do bring home a goldfish, feed it well and be nice to it!

33105.name: Pond
33105.describe: Invites you to sit down next to it and pond-er life's great questions.

33106.name: Festival Kadomatsu
33106.describe: Looks like a certain Eagle Union light cruiser has tried her hand at something more elaborate than usual.

33107.name: Cut-Ton
33107.describe: A pun on "cotton" and "cut." Aptly describes what this evil roll of cloth will do to you!

33108.name: Festival Lantern
33108.describe: Stay awhile and listen under the warm glow of this lantern.

33109.name: Kappa Manjuu
33109.describe: Feeds on cucumbers and invents things. Not to be confused with the monochrome emote.

33110.name: Festival Bandstand
33110.describe: It's probably closer to a pavilion than a bandstand, but who has time to argue over that? The Kagura dance is about to start!

33111.name: Chocolate Banana
33111.describe: This has got to be the silliest chocolate banana anyone's ever made...

33112.name: Rideable Aubergine
33112.describe: "I know what you're thinking, but don't say it. Kids are listening..."

33113.name: Cucumbequine
33113.describe: A mockup of a rejected picket monster design.

33114.name: Shogi Piece Lanterns
33114.describe: What kind of tactician thought it'd be a good idea to put this many lanterns together in one place?

33115.name: Guest Room Furnishings
33115.describe: For people not so used to sitting on the floor.

33116.name: Horned Demon Mask
33116.describe: "Zoinks! I'm too young to die in the maws of a haunted mask!"

33117.name: Ghost Manjuu
33117.describe: A Manjuu wearing a lot of makeup. It's still a ghost, of course, it's just not usually this pale.

33118.name: Haunting Ember
33118.describe: "Boooooo, I am a ghooooost...! Visit Shiranui's stooooooore...!"

33119.name: Geyeant
33119.describe: Not particularly creepy. Its next door neighbor, the man-eating piano, however...

33120.name: Hanging Lanterns
33120.describe: The red ones are the prettiest, aren't they?

33121.name: White Pupper
33121.describe: This regal pupper has no interest in meat still attached to the bone. It views it as "peasant food."

33122.name: Festival Drums
33122.describe: You've seen these before. Question is, will your rhythm game skills help?

33123.name: Albino Fox Bridge
33123.describe: Bridging the gap between you and a very hungry-looking fox.

33301.name: Tree Painting
33301.describe: Wood-n't say it's the most in-tree-esting subject at its roots. Still, it leafs a nice impression.

33303.name: Manjuu Picture Frame
33303.describe: It's a flat image, but it looks three-dimensional at the right angle. Luckily, you're viewing it from that angle right now!

33304.name: Mountain Wall Scroll
33304.describe: All the core Sakura Empire aesthetics summarized with one gorgeous picture.

33305.name: Aunty Decor
33305.describe: She's always watching you... silently... and making sure you eat lots and grow up to be strong, ya hear!

33306.name: Sliding Door
33306.describe: Is there to remind you that, no matter how much you decorate the place, you're still having a festival indoors.

35001.name: Ghostly Wilderness
35001.describe: A wilderness full of wandering ghosts.

35002.name: Blackened Grass
35002.describe: This field of grass is hiding...many many secrets.

35101.name: Tiny Haystack
35101.describe: A seemingly ordinary tiny pile of haystack.

35102.name: Handcart
35102.describe: Where did this pile of bones come from?

35104.name: Skull Sewn Carpet
35104.describe: A big purple carpet, its sewn seems to contain some strange meaning.

35105.name: Gravel Trail
35105.describe: A path made of gravel. Don’t walk on it in barefoot.

35106.name: Levitating Cloak
35106.describe: Come guess what is underneath this cloak.

35107.name: Black Spear Fence
35107.describe: A row of black spears laced with purple cloth.

35108.name: Golden Railing
35108.describe: This does not fit the courtyard style at all.

35109.name: Large Haunted House
35109.describe: The highlight of this courtyard, the witch’s masterpiece!

35110.name: Turkey
35110.describe: What are we having for Halloween...

35111.name: Mummy
35111.describe: I have been resurrected from the dead!

35112.name: Graveyard
35112.describe: This pit feels like the right size.

35113.name: Pumpkin Lantern
35113.describe: The Pumpkin light is watching you.

35114.name: Street Sign
35114.describe: My friend, if you’re lost then look over here!

35115.name: Spider Webbed Tombstone
35115.describe: The tombstone has accumulated spider webs.

35116.name: Tombstone Memorial
35116.describe: Commemorating XXX (The writing seems to be blurry).

35117.name: Giant Pumpkin Lamp
35117.describe: Giant pumpkin lamp that can also be used as a storage box.

35118.name: Pile of Pumpkin Lights
35118.describe: A little pile of mini pumpkin lights.

35119.name: Broomstick
35119.describe: A broomstick which you so dearly deserve!

35125.name: Withered Trunk
35125.describe: A withered trunk that’s oozing out green goo.

35126.name: Poisonous Swamp
35126.describe: A pool bubbling with purple liquid.

35127.name: Dinner Table
35127.describe: Welcome everyone, what would you like to eat?

35128.name: White Ghost
35128.describe: Wahahaha~ Try and catch me if you can!

35129.name: Pumpkin Knight
35129.describe: It is my honor to take you on my horse, miss?

35205.name: Candlestick
35205.describe: A standard red candlestick for banquets.

35302.name: Bright Moon
35302.describe: A bright moon illuminating the dark night.

37001.name: Snowy Christmas
37001.describe: Wallpaper decked out with the romantic component of a Snowy Holy Night. Or Christmas for short.

37002.name: Shopping District Tiling
37002.describe: Tiling which you just need for that Royal townscape look.

37101.name: Shop
37101.describe: A shop painted with the colors of Christmas. Maybe they sell presents too?

37102.name: Snowflake Windmill
37102.describe: The blades spin. The snowflakes spin. The wintry winds caresses the town.

37103.name: Reindeer Traffic Light
37103.describe: Everyone's gotta follow the rules of the road, even Santa!

37104.name: Train Stop
37104.describe: Normally used to take shelter from the rain.

37105.name: Flower Present
37105.describe: Many pretty flowers come sprouting out of this present bag when opened. Nobody knows how.

37106.name: Christmas Train
37106.describe: A whole train loaded with presents. No more than one present per person!

37108.name: Christmas Gate
37108.describe: A door decorated with Christmas lights and a wreath. Merry Christmas!

37109.name: Chocolate Ball
37109.describe: A yummy-looking chocolate ball. Do you think the star is edible too?

37110.name: Chocolate Fountain
37110.describe: A chocolate fountain designed to look like a Christmas tree. "Perfect for balancing out your blood sugar levels♪"

37111.name: Ticket Booth
37111.describe: A ticket booth with Santa on top. They don't sell lottery tickets.

37112.name: Christmas Tree
37112.describe: Everyone worked together to make this gorgeous Christmas tree.

37113.name: Christmas Branch
37113.describe: All it needs is the chance to grow to become a big and beautiful Christmas tree!

37114.name: Sewer Hole
37114.describe: Loaded to capacity with Manjuu. Not a viable escape route for those suffering from Christmas spirit intoxication...

37116.name: Snowman Bath
37116.describe: It looks like a big snowman, but it's actually a bath that became a snowman.

37117.name: Reindeer Postmanjuu
37117.describe: This Manjuu has come to sell you Christmas cards.

37118.name: Post Box
37118.describe: A red post box. Let's check if there are any presents inside!

37119.name: Shopping District Plaza
37119.describe: A run-of-the-mill plaza paved with stone.

37121.name: Christmas Car
37121.describe: Let's just give the reindeer this year off.

37122.name: Christmas Swingset
37122.describe: Fun for kids around the world! Caution: may be cold to sit on at first.

38001.name: Boar Forest
38001.describe: Wallpaper that makes all the boars feel at home.

38002.name: Boar Grass
38002.describe: Floor that just feels natural. Don't eat the grass though, it's fake.

38101.name: Boar Chair
38101.describe: Totally fine to sit on, just don't try it with a real boar.

38102.name: Boar Bus
38102.describe: Does it look like a Neighbor, or a Friend?

38103.name: Boar Bed
38103.describe: You'll snore like a boar when you sleep in this bed.

38104.name: Fluffy Lamp
38104.describe: It's almost hard to believe how fluffy the lampshade is.

38105.name: Large Stone
38105.describe: A plain old rock. Take care not to slip on it!

38106.name: Small Stone
38106.describe: A plain old rock. Be careful of the moss!

38107.name: Living Room Carpet
38107.describe: A carpet that belongs in a living room. Very nice texture.

38108.name: Chocoblock Tiles
38108.describe: Square tiles painted in the color of chocolate. Not edible, but won't melt!

38109.name: Campfire
38109.describe: A small campfire you and your friends can sit around and tell stories.

38110.name: Bonsai Tree
38110.describe: "No, not that one! It's still growing!"

38111.name: Bonsai Tree (Big)
38111.describe: "You gotta water it every morning! Don't forget it!"

38112.name: Ceramic Flower Bed
38112.describe: "One day I'd like to grow roses in it."

38113.name: Boar Prints
38113.describe: There's a boar somewhere in our peaceful dormitory...!

38115.name: Shiitake Mushroom
38115.describe: Goes well with meat stew, but won't give you an extra life.

38116.name: Log Rack
38116.describe: There's a captain's log in there somewhere.

38117.name: Mineral Mud Bath
38117.describe: How come kids play in the mud but adults bathe in it?

38118.name: Boar Balloons
38118.describe: There are 2 regular balloons and one BOARloon.

38119.name: Slab of Meat (Big)
38119.describe: Is it a drumstick? What's it from? Nobody knows. Still delicious, though.

38120.name: BBQ Grill
38120.describe: Keeps the fire safely contained and perfectly ventilated.

38121.name: Ambush
38121.describe: This boar is waiting to am-bush its prey.

38122.name: Big Bookcase
38122.describe: A certain someone made it nice and tidy for you.

38123.name: Boar Carpet
38123.describe: A fluffy carpet with a friendly boar sitting on it.

38124.name: Indoor Slippers
38124.describe: Not everyone wears shoes indoors, but anyone can wear slippers indoors.

38125.name: Pet Boar
38125.describe: A boar on a rampage. Well, it's standing still now, but...

38126.name: Clothes Rack
38126.describe: A rack to hang all your nice clothes on.

38127.name: Boar Sofa (Big)
38127.describe: No pillow fights allowed. We're not animals.

38128.name: Boar Sofa (Small)
38128.describe: No pillow fights allowed. It's BOARderline dangerous.

38129.name: Boar Tent
38129.describe: A tent with a novel design. Might attract wild boars.

38130.name: Standing Dinner Table
38130.describe: You stand while eating at this table. You can add chairs if you want, but then what's the point?

38131.name: Boar Table
38131.describe: A table perfect for eating stake at.

38132.name: Boar Nose Chair
38132.describe: A round chair with a big boar's nose drawn on it. Some people say it looks like a heart.

38133.name: Dressing Table
38133.describe: "Change my style? Not this again, Kumano..."

38201.name: Grilled Drumsticks
38201.describe: Meat is great, but don't forget to eat your vegetables too.

38301.name: Red Wallpaper
38301.describe: Some Asian cultures believe this color brings good luck.

38302.name: Boar Forest Window
38302.describe: A window beyond which lays a beautiful snowy landscape and lots of boars. ...Wait, boars?

38304.name: Tusk Window
38304.describe: "Just look at all those cute little clouds~"

38305.name: Storage Shelf
38305.describe: A shelf that's mounted so high that destroyers can't really reach it.

39001.name: Boar Year Wallpaper
39001.describe: Wallpaper that puts you in the mood to celebrate this happy day.

39002.name: Boar Year Flooring
39002.describe: Finely created Dragon Empery-style wooden flooring. Even expert craftsmen would have trouble replicating it.

39101.name: Plum Plant
39101.describe: Don't forget to water it regularly.

39102.name: Pork Buns
39102.describe: 'They're so cute... but I'll still eat them! I'm so hungry!'

39103.name: Dragon Empery Tea Table
39103.describe: Some people can get through any rough day with some tea. Others do it with coffee.

39104.name: Big Crimson Bed
39104.describe: A big bed that has room for 2. Or just 1, if they're the type that needs personal space.

39105.name: Golden Piggy Bank
39105.describe: Might be worth more than any amount of money you can store in it!

39106.name: Holiday Carpet (Red)
39106.describe: A hand-knitted carpet that's almost too beautiful to walk over.

39107.name: Holiday Carpet (White)
39107.describe: A hand-knitted carpet that's almost too beautiful to walk over.

39108.name: Pig Grab Bag
39108.describe: Say oink 3 times before opening and you might get lucky!

39109.name: Display Rack
39109.describe: Has various New Year's treasures on display.

39110.name: Wooden Side Table
39110.describe: Dragon Empery-style side table. Feels retro yet premium at the same time.

39111.name: Cloth Tiger
39111.describe: A little tiger made from cloth. Stronger than one made from paper, but weaker than a real tiger.

39112.name: Traditional Medicine Bath
39112.describe: A traditional medicine bath that could get you drunk if you stay in it for too long.

39113.name: Empery Aged Wine
39113.describe: Don't let kids or destroyers drink! Especially not if they're both!

39114.name: Plum Folding Screen
39114.describe: Dragon Empery-style folding screen. Hides less beyond the screen than you'd hope.

39115.name: Calligraphy Table
39115.describe: A wonderful invention so you won't need to write on the ground anymore. Takao is sure to appreciate it.

39116.name: Pork Balls
39116.describe: Balls made from glutinous rice. You can't deny they worked too hard on the exterior appearance.

39117.name: Pig Sofa (Small)
39117.describe: A small red sofa that suits the holiday mood well.

39118.name: Pig Relaxation
39118.describe: A red lounge chair that suits the holiday mood well.

39119.name: Pig Sofa (Big)
39119.describe: A big red sofa that suits the holiday mood well.

39120.name: Dining Table Chair
39120.describe: A chair that's intended to be paired with a, you guessed it, dining table.

39121.name: Silver Sycee
39121.describe: Served as a form of currency long ago. It appears to be golden, so we don't know why it's called a silver sycee.

39122.name: Dragon Empery Table
39122.describe: Table designed to compliment Dragon Empery cuisine better than any other.

39123.name: Pig Cushion
39123.describe: 'Wait, you're supposed to put it on your head?!'

39124.name: Lucky Floor Cushion
39124.describe: It only brings luck once you place it on the floor. Otherwise it's just a normal cushion.

39125.name: Money-Making Bonsai
39125.describe: They say money doesn't grow on trees, but this little guy might prove them wrong.

39126.name: Hotpot (Big)
39126.describe: A hearty meal that's a favorite in the Dragon Empery.

39201.name: Hotpot (Small)
39201.describe: A hearty meal that's a favorite in the Dragon Empery.

39202.name: New Year's Gifts
39202.describe: Envelopes containing money, meant to be given away to friends and family on New Year's.

39203.name: Fruit Basket
39203.describe: Basket filled with fruit you'd have a hard time finding during winter.

39301.name: Silk Veil Window (Red)
39301.describe: The scenery beyond the veils feels rather captivating.

39302.name: Hanging Character (Chun)
39302.describe: It means 'spring.' Hang it on the wall to welcome the end of winter.

39303.name: Hanging Curtain (Luck)
39303.describe: One of a set of two curtains that bring good luck when hung up.

39304.name: Hanging Curtain (Hope)
39304.describe: One of a set of two curtains that bring good luck when hung up.

39305.name: Wooden Window
39305.describe: A wooden window beyond which lies some nice scenery.

39306.name: Landscape Picture
39306.describe: A detailed painting of an astonishingly beautiful landscape. Its author is unknown.

39307.name: Dragon Empery Window
39307.describe: A Dragon Empery-style hexagonal window that opens to reveal a gorgeous garden.

40001.name: Snowy Mountains Wallpaper
40001.describe: You feel on top of the world, at least geographically.

40002.name: Snowy Flooring
40002.describe: The snow feels perfect for skiing.

40101.name: Igloo
40101.describe: It's warmer inside than outside, thanks to the magic of insulation.

40102.name: Snowy Bush
40102.describe: Greenery must be hardy to survive in these climes.

40103.name: Wooden Crate
40103.describe: A box loaded with timber, your best fuel source up here.

40104.name: Snowy Hot Spring
40104.describe: A warm bath AND a spectacular view? What more could you want?

40105.name: Kerosene Lantern
40105.describe: At night, this light helps fend off both the forces of cold and dark.

40106.name: Ice Sculpture
40106.describe: This is some very impressive craftsmanship.

40107.name: Baked Potato Grill
40107.describe: Someone fashioned this drum into a grill. While odd, it does seem to bake the potatoes perfectly.

40108.name: Little Seal
40108.describe: Her name is Sally. Isn't she cute?

40109.name: Scarf Manjuu
40109.describe: This manjuu is extremely underequipped for these temperatures. Please don't try this at home.

40110.name: Ice Fishing Hole
40110.describe: Maybe you can catch a fish or two? Just watch your step around it.

40111.name: Snowy Fence
40111.describe: Draws a line between the ski resort and the wilderness.

40114.name: Penguinjuu
40114.describe: A manjuu that skipped right past evolution and willed itself into a penguin.

40115.name: Large Snowball
40115.describe: A snowball fit for a giant, or a snowman in its infancy?

40116.name: Snowy Stone
40116.describe: Watch out for these when you're on your skis.

40117.name: Snowy Tree
40117.describe: Greenery must be hardy to survive in these climes.

40118.name: Polar Bear
40118.describe: This apex predator is surprisingly friendly.

40119.name: Snow Boots
40119.describe: Protects against snow, the cold, and slipping.

40121.name: Snowy Bench
40121.describe: Tired from all the skiing? Sit down and catch your breath.

40123.name: Tall Fence
40123.describe: Okay, you're definitely not getting over this one.

40124.name: Snowy Tent
40124.describe: Akatsuki set it up. There's ninja gear inside.

40125.name: Snowy Slide
40125.describe: You can slide right down this slope even without skis.

40126.name: Ski Lift
40126.describe: It only moves you an extremely short distance, but it beats walking.

41001.name: Rollercoaster Wallpaper
41001.describe: Experience thrills and chills on these two-dimensional valleys and hills!

41002.name: Amusement Park Flooring
41002.describe: Specially crafted to prevent children from tripping.

41101.name: Bulletin Board
41101.describe: So much to do, so much to see! Where should we go next?

41102.name: Lime Teacup
41102.describe: Although designed to look like a teacup, it appears to contain coffee.

41103.name: Strawberry Teacup
41103.describe: Although designed to look like a teacup, it appears to contain coffee.

41104.name: Grape Teacup
41104.describe: Although designed to look like a teacup, it appears to contain coffee.

41106.name: Pirate Ship
41106.describe: We heard you like ships, so you can put a ship on this ship.

41107.name: Potted Heart Plant
41107.describe: Money doesn't grow on trees, but maybe love does...?

41108.name: Flowerbed
41108.describe: Increases the Joy factor of nearby Rides by 3.5%. Allegedly.

41109.name: Cotton Candy Cart
41109.describe: "I've never tasted candy like that before! I want one, Ark!"

41110.name: Bumper Cars
41110.describe: The only kinds of cars that don't require a sober mind or a license!

41111.name: Manjuu Fountain
41111.describe: Rumor has it that shooting it for a few minutes triggers a secret boss battle.

41112.name: Hotdog Wagon
41112.describe: All hotdogs sold here contain only Union-approved additives!

41113.name: Apple Tree
41113.describe: Stay under it for long enough and you might get a free snack! Or a concussion.

41114.name: Ice Cream Stand
41114.describe: You scream, I scream, we all scream for ice cream.

41115.name: Amusement Park Bench
41115.describe: Having too much fun? Sit down and have a break!

41116.name: Merry-Go-Round
41116.describe: The horses on the ride go round and round, round and round...

41117.name: Manjuu Blimp
41117.describe: To go where no ship has gone before... to the skies!

42001.name: Traditional Wallpaper
42001.describe: The patterns and colors of this wallpaper evoke tranquil memories of time spent with family.

42002.name: Authentic Floorboards
42002.describe: Traditional floorboards carefully crafted from real wood. Feels nice and cozy underneath your feet~

42101.name: Kimchi Bed
42101.describe: A bed inspired by everyone's favorite fermented dish. Don't eat the props though!

42102.name: Model Battleship
42102.describe: You don't need heavy plating to sally forth and overcome any hardship!

42103.name: Small Bench
42103.describe: A traditional-styled wooden bench. Sitting on it seems to transport you to the past.

42104.name: Delicious Bibimbap
42104.describe: Freshly-prepared bibimbap. The delicious aroma of rice and vegetables wafts into your nostrils.

42105.name: Small Dining Table
42105.describe: Come forth and partake of the deliciousness!

42106.name: Pickling Jar
42106.describe: Be patient! Its contents are better with age!

42107.name: Wooden Windscreen
42107.describe: How can something be so simple but elegant? So practical yet so artistic?

42108.name: Traditional Drum
42108.describe: A drum used in many celebrations. The urge to pound out some beats is unbearable.

42109.name: Mug of Beer
42109.describe: Glug... glug... glug... phew~! Ahh, beverages are best enjoyed like this.

42110.name: Barbecue Table
42110.describe: Don't let its appearances fool you. This is yet another battleground. First come first served!

42111.name: Precious Herbs
42111.describe: The East is famous for its miraculous herbalism. Wonder if there's anything that will make me cuter...

42112.name: Tteokbokki
42112.describe: A piping-hot plate of fried spicy rice cakes, one of the world's most beloved street foods.

42113.name: Replica Tower
42113.describe: If only it came with the ability to light up as well...

42114.name: Doenjang Guk
42114.describe: Silky and refreshing, this warm and comforting soy drink is the real liquid happiness.

42115.name: Grape Juice
42115.describe: A can of grape juice, straight out of the fridge. There are little jelly pieces at the bottom.

42116.name: Orange Juice
42116.describe: Orange juice is a universally beloved drink. Of course there's pulp.

42117.name: Fried Chicken
42117.describe: Grab-and-go deliciousness for your busy schedule!

42118.name: Tea Table
42118.describe: Equally suited for enjoying tea and gossipping about the shipgirls next door.

42119.name: Yut Nori Game Table
42119.describe: A traditional board game. Let's teach everyone how to play!

42120.name: Buk Table
42120.describe: Is it a table, or is it a drum?

42121.name: Janggo Table
42121.describe: Is it a table, or is it a long drum?

42122.name: Traditional Cushion
42122.describe: Craftsmanship was certainly better back then... No matter how much you squeeze this cushion, it won't lose its shape.

42123.name: Yuts
42123.describe: Game pieces for the yuts table. Tossing these takes some finesse. Hiyah~!

42301.name: Traditional Wooden Window
42301.describe: Though it's made of wood, it looks undeniably sturdy and beautiful.

42302.name: Floral Window Decor
42302.describe: A necessary component in the room. It is said that this flower symbolizes a promise for the future.

42303.name: Hibiscus Wall Decor
42303.describe: A beautiful ornament of an iconic flower. It even gives off a faint, sweet scent.

42304.name: Traditional Sliding Door
42304.describe: A simple but effective sliding door. It gives off an earthy smell when it slides across the ground.

43001.name: Virtual Wallpaper
43001.describe: Wallpaper made to look like the "white space" Kizuna AI lives in. Now you too can have a virtual room!

43002.name: Virtual Flooring
43002.describe: Flooring made to look like the "white space" Kizuna AI lives in. Now you too can have a virtual room!

43101.name: Easel
43101.describe: An easel that Kizuna AI made herself. You can decorate it with your favorite pictures.

43102.name: Snack Ai Sofa
43102.describe: A sofa and table from the Snack AI series. We recommend the ginger ale.

43103.name: Kizuna AI Fridge
43103.describe: A super high-tech fridge. Kizuna AI can control its temperature.

43104.name: A.I.-Equipped Bed
43104.describe: A bed equipped with an artificial intelligence. The A.I. schedules your naptime so you get the optimum amount of beauty sleep!

43105.name: A.I.-Equipped Kitchen
43105.describe: A kitchen equipped with a highly advanced A.I. to make it easy to use. Just upload your recipe, and the food makes itself! ... In theory, anyway.

43106.name: Kizuna AI Stool
43106.describe: A stool that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. "It's light and durable, so it won't break easily!"

43107.name: Kizuna AI Chair
43107.describe: A chair that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. "Why's there no backrest? Because backrests contribute to bad posture."

43108.name: Heart Seat
43108.describe: A heart-shaped seat that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. It's actually pretty cushy.

43109.name: 4K Kizuna AI Television
43109.describe: It almost makes videos look realer than reality itself. It makes games feel more immersive, too!

43110.name: Headband Rug
43110.describe: A rug that's reminiscent of the headband Kizuna AI wears.

43111.name: Kizuna AI Carpet
43111.describe: A carpet that's reminiscent of the super smart artificial intelligence Kizuna AI.

43112.name: Random Word Generator
43112.describe: A device that looks like the strange box that ended up in the same world as Kizuna AI. "The real thing is even cooler!"

43113.name: AI-Equipped Bottle Rack
43113.describe: A bottle rack from the Snack AI series. "I recommend that there A.I. Whiskey, but don't drink none till yer 21!"

43114.name: Kitty Cat
43114.describe: Just a normal cat. Not a munchkin, not a parrot, not a techitechi bird.

43115.name: A.I. Nursing Device
43115.describe: A nursing device equipped with an A.I. that's highly advanced. Standing inside it restores your energy quicker than usual. Maybe.

43116.name: Virtual Potted Plant
43116.describe: A virtual potted plant shaped like a heart. "It's virtual, so it can take on any shape you want! It's really fun to see it change!"

43117.name: L-Shaped Kizuna AI Sofa
43117.describe: A multifunction sofa that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. It has lots of storage slots to make the most use of its space.

43118.name: A.I. Closet
43118.describe: A closet that stores various items styled after Kizuna AI. "Now you can be Kizuna AI whenever you want!"

43119.name: Kizuna AI Sofa
43119.describe: A sofa that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. There's not anything particularly virtual about it. "Whaddya mean it's not virtual?!"

43120.name: A.I. Bathtub
43120.describe: A bathtub that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. "You can place your device on the transparent board to watch my videos while in the bath!"

43121.name: A.I. Desk
43121.describe: A desk that's reminiscent of the one Kizuna AI uses when she does cool work. With this fantastic triple-screen setup you can edit videos faster... in theory.

43122.name: Round A.I. Table
43122.describe: A big, round table that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. You can make friends easily if you sit in a circle around this table!

43123.name: A.I. Stage
43123.describe: A stage prepared for Kizuna AI when she hosts a concert at the base. There's a heart-shaped monitor on the back which lets you do all kinds of effects and stuff.

43201.name: A.I. Glow Stick
43201.describe: A glow stick that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. Don't forget to bring it with you to her concert, or else you might feel so ashamed you'll want to run away.

43202.name: A.I. Controller
43202.describe: A controller that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. It comes equipped with an artificial intelligence, so even if you suck at games, it'll help you play like a pro... in theory.

43205.name: A.I. Cushion
43205.describe: A cushion that's reminiscent of Kizuna AI. In particular, pro gamer Kizuna AI with short hair.

43301.name: A.I. Concert Poster
43301.describe: A poster that might be used to advertise Kizuna AI's first concert. "Hello, world!"

43302.name: A.I. Clothes Rack
43302.describe: Kizuna AI's clothes rack. Just by wearing a white coat and a pair of glasses, people will think you're intelligent... probably.

43303.name: A.I. Bookshelf
43303.describe: A bookcase where Kizuna AI leaves books she's done reading. She seems happy to be able to read physical, real-life books.

43304.name: Portal To Anywhere
43304.describe: One of Kizuna AI's secret tools. Most of the worlds she visit have a high difficulty setting.

43305.name: Virtual Screen
43305.describe: A high-tech screen that uses the latest projection technology. "With this, you can watch me on the big screen, no matter where you are!"

43306.name: Heart-Shaped Shelf
43306.describe: A great place for your game cases. It has lots of games that Kizuna AI bought so she could stream them.

43307.name: Kizuna AI Letter Boxes
43307.describe: Letter boxes that spell out the name of the super intelligent Kizuna AI. - "Kizuna AI... was a good person. I will miss her." - "Hey, I'm still alive!"

44001.name: Rain-Drenched Flooring
44001.describe: The ground splishes and splashes as you walk over it.

44002.name: Rain-Drenched Wallpaper
44002.describe: Faint traces of summer remain in the brickwork.

44101.name: Rain-Drenched Grass Patch
44101.describe: The breath of life is wet and strong.

44102.name: Yellow School Bus
44102.describe: A little rain won't stop this locomotor from running on time.

44103.name: Rain-Drenched Bush
44103.describe: Tiny puddles have accumulated on the countless leaves.

44104.name: Rain-Drenched Flower Bed
44104.describe: However you feel about rain, these plants welcome it with open... stalks?

44106.name: Drying Machine
44106.describe: Step inside, wait 50 seconds, and you'll come out completely dry!

44110.name: Rainy Bus Stop
44110.describe: Missed the bus? Don't worry, the next one comes in 20 minutes.

44111.name: Upright Parasol
44111.describe: A good place to seek shelter from the rain.

44112.name: Toppled Parasol
44112.describe: Uh-oh. Someone should do something about that.

44113.name: Rainy Fire Hydrant
44113.describe: More water is the last thing you need right now.

44114.name: Rainy Fountain
44114.describe: It's probably best not to drink from it.

44115.name: Teru Teru Bouzu
44115.describe: Children hang these up as charms to make the rain clear up.

44116.name: Booties Bathtub
44116.describe: Only a giant could wear these... They're spacious enough to bathe in, though.

44117.name: Rainy Café Chair
44117.describe: Sitting on it, you yearn to be indoors with a warm cup of coffee.

44118.name: Rainy Bench
44118.describe: It feels like it always takes ages for the rain on a bench to dry.

44119.name: Manjuu with Big Leaf
44119.describe: When you don't have an umbrella, you sometimes have to improvise.

44120.name: Manjuu Raincoat
44120.describe: Yes! This is exactly what you need right now!

44121.name: Rainy Parasol Table
44121.describe: For café customers. Why don't you drop in and order something?

44122.name: Rainy Table
44122.describe: For the bold customer who doesn't mind standing in the rain.

44123.name: Thunder Cloud
44123.describe: Place a person on top and rain thunder from the sky!

44301.name: Rainy Window
44301.describe: The cute little flowers on the windowsill make it feel like it's still spring.

44302.name: Rainy Café Window
44302.describe: Just large enough to offer protection from the rain.

45001.name: Iron Blood Scherzo Flooring
45001.describe: Open your ears and listen. Do you hear it? That's the Iron Blood's nostalgic scherzo.

45002.name: Iron Blood Scherzo Wallpaper
45002.describe: Open your ears and listen. Do you hear it? That's the Iron Blood's nostalgic scherzo.

45101.name: Old Projector
45101.describe: It's quite old. So old nobody alive knows if it still works.

45102.name: Floor Lamp
45102.describe: A floor lamp with a simple design. They say simple is best, after all!

45103.name: Feather Carpet
45103.describe: Don't have a fox to lend you a tail? Just roll around inside this carpet!

45104.name: Large Feather Carpet
45104.describe: Don't have a fox to lend you a tail? Just roll around inside this carpet! IT'S MASSIVE!

45105.name: Coat of Arms Carpet
45105.describe: A carpet decorated with some kind of coat of arms. Fairly symmetrical and nice to look at.

45106.name: Glass Display Case
45106.describe: Filled with all sorts of peculiarities, rare items, medals, and the like.

45107.name: Trumpet
45107.describe: "Fool! I toot it as I please!"

45108.name: Cupboard with Lamp
45108.describe: Without stapling it to the wall, you need SOMETHING for the lamp to sit on!

45109.name: Wooden Shoe Shelf
45109.describe: Practical storage space made in Iron Blood style.

45110.name: Record Collection
45110.describe: Keep all your favorite records in one place so they don't break.

45111.name: Manjuu Fanfare Band
45111.describe: "May the God of war be with you! Fanfare band, begin!"

45112.name: Manjuu Honorary Guard
45112.describe: "Lift your chin, puff out your chest, and let me see those eyes!"

45113.name: Gramophone
45113.describe: When both the music and the way of playing it are really old, you've got some top-level nostalgia.

45114.name: Soldier's Armor
45114.describe: Heavy-looking armor. You might feel invincible while wearing it, but you are still susceptible to flesh wounds.

45115.name: Spiral Staircase
45115.describe: Could theoretically be spun upside down and still work.

45116.name: Magnificent Piano
45116.describe: You wouldn't believe how many Manjuu it took to get it in here...

45117.name: Nutcracker Soldier - Sword
45117.describe: A nutcracker soldier holding a sword. It has an uncanny resemblance to a certain someone...

45118.name: Nutcracker Soldier - Rifle
45118.describe: A nutcracker soldier holding a rifle. It has an uncanny resemblance to a certain someone...

45119.name: Nostalgic Bookcase
45119.describe: An almost overwhelmingly nostalgic bookcase. Think of all the memories that are stored here.

45120.name: Iron Blood Flag Stand
45120.describe: The flags symbolize a resolve of steel and a mind of iron.

45121.name: Legless Chair
45121.describe: "It's not legless, it's just retracted them! Chairs need rest too, sometimes!"

45122.name: Soft-backed Chair
45122.describe: A delightfully soft chair, it seats one.

45123.name: Office Chair
45123.describe: With such a fine, outstanding office chair at your back, there's no doubt your productivity will shoot up!

45125.name: Delightful Shrub
45125.describe: Some greenery makes for a better work environment.

45126.name: Little Round Table
45126.describe: It's the kind of table you sit around and chat over at a classy party.

45127.name: Wooden Coffee Table
45127.describe: You're allowed to use it for tea too, if you want.

45128.name: Wine Rack
45128.describe: Seems like there's a bottle of the good stuff missing.

45129.name: Iron Blood Desk
45129.describe: It seems like there's always one more document left to review.

45130.name: Cluttered Table
45130.describe: This table has so many books and papers, its owner must be far too busy to tidy it up.

45131.name: Iron Blood Candelabra
45131.describe: The melting candles bring a feeling of refined nostalgia to the room.

45132.name: Iron Blood Throne
45132.describe: It is said to be deliberately uncomfortable, as a ruler should never take the throne lightly.

45133.name: Iron Blood Podium
45133.describe: For when you need to deliver a rousing if morally questionable speech.

45201.name: Table Lamp
45201.describe: This lamp emits a soft, warm light from whatever table it graces.

45202.name: Iron Blood Brandy
45202.describe: Pull this bottle from its icy home when you have something to celebrate. Prost!

45203.name: Iron Blood Bust
45203.describe: Neither Graf Zeppelin's nor Prinz Eugen's, some would call this Iron Blood bust a disappointment.

45301.name: Window
45301.describe: This splendid glass window comes with a set of lovely black curtains.

45302.name: Wall Lamp
45302.describe: This lamp emits a soft, warm light from whatever wall you slap it on.

45303.name: Photo Collection
45303.describe: Set all your treasured photographs in this and then put it on your desk to admire.

45304.name: Wall Cross
45304.describe: A symbol of great importance to the Iron Blood fleet, hang it in a place of honor.

45305.name: Magnificent Wall Cross
45305.describe: Look at this cross and contemplate how much more magnificent it is than the other one.

45306.name: An Art
45306.describe: This is art, Iron Blood style, we think. Enjoy it in moderation.

45307.name: Magnificent Doorway
45307.describe: Could this magnificent doorway stand between you and heaven itself?

45308.name: Banner
45308.describe: Hang this on the wall and enjoy its totally nonthreatening "X" ensign.

45309.name: Black and White Picture Frame
45309.describe: Bismarck's official portrait. She gives off a sense of gravitas.

45310.name: Wooden Coat Rack
45310.describe: Every Commander needs somewhere to hang his hat.

46001.name: Fiber Flooring
46001.describe: Not the type of fiber that aids digestion.

46002.name: Circuitry Wallpaper
46002.describe: Powered by 1's and 0's behind the scenes.

46101.name: Digital Vinyl Turntable
46101.describe: A new fad with the kids. They say the bits are played back much more clearly on vinyl than on isolinear chips.

46102.name: Nutrient Bath
46102.describe: A 30 minute dip in this will ward off fatigue for 8 hours.

46103.name: Crosswalk Tile
46103.describe: Any Users caught jaywalking may be fined up to CS$7,800.

46104.name: Neon Lips
46104.describe: A neon sign draws in customers, even if what's on the sign is irrelevant to what you sell or do!

46105.name: Blue Digital Pillar
46105.describe: Not green, ergo not radioactive. Probably.

46106.name: Yellow Digital Pillar
46106.describe: Not green, ergo not radioactive. Probably.

46107.name: Cathode Ray Tube TV
46107.describe: As it turns out, cathode ray tube TVs were so ahead of their time that they eventually went full circle and replaced quantum dot displays.

46108.name: Disc Carpet
46108.describe: It's actually pretty fragile, so don't step on it.

46109.name: Broken Monitor
46109.describe: "Not sure what broke 'er. Mighta been hackers on steroids, mighta been dead pixel rain. Either way, she don't work."

46110.name: Digital Manhole Cover
46110.describe: It's purely decorative. You won't find a digital drainage system underneath.

46111.name: Wingbot SN01
46111.describe: Sentient Wingbot. Wonders if, when permanently deactivated, it will dream of electric sheep. Nobody knows the answer.

46112.name: Wingbot SN02
46112.describe: It wants to be a personal assistant one day, like its great great grandroid once was.

46113.name: Microbot
46113.describe: The question is: is it a micro bot, or a mic robot?

46114.name: No-Crossing Wall
46114.describe: "Are they havin' a laugh? What's no-crossing tape over a wall gonna do? Stop that red juice pitcher bloke?"

46115.name: NEON Sign
46115.describe: Seems weird at first, but it makes sense when you consider it was originally hung over the entrance to a neon sign factory.

46116.name: Wave Sign
46116.describe: This sign has 2 display settings: "audio waveform" and "tidal wave impression."

46117.name: Heart Sign
46117.describe: This sign just wants to wish you a nice day.

46118.name: Road Tile
46118.describe: Remember to look both ways. Or else the security cameras can't ID you.

46119.name: Air Circulation Device
46119.describe: "Thing's so darn loud you can't tell if it's circulating air or just generating noise."

46120.name: Stop Sign
46120.describe: Usually a good sign that you should stop.

46121.name: Sleep Pod
46121.describe: It's time to lie down and recharge your batteries, be it literally or not.

46122.name: Purple Air Cube
46122.describe: The cube's makers have not disclosed what chemicals are used to create this particular hue.

46123.name: Lime Air Cube
46123.describe: "Lime" as in the color. Don't try to eat it.

46124.name: Blue Air Cube
46124.describe: Widely considered the cube with the most "natural" color. Regardless, its carbon footprint makes environmentalists cry.

46125.name: Holographic Fence
46125.describe: Keeps data thieves out! Or at least forces them to surmount it.

46126.name: Projector
46126.describe: "Do you have gorgeous decorations you want to display but are afraid of burglars? Don't fret, just project!"

46127.name: Hovertable
46127.describe: A lot more expensive and not much more practical than a regular table, but it'll impress your friends.

46128.name: Exposed Circuitry
46128.describe: Plausible causes: digital vandalism, or just regular old vandalism.

46129.name: Hovercar
46129.describe: Tired of the silence of the mute city? Then jump in and ride the death wind down to see the big blue of port town.

46130.name: Schrödinger's Hologram
46130.describe: The only way to know if it's on or not is to check.

46131.name: Teleporter Gate
46131.describe: A Generation II teleporter gate. Safer than the previous Generation, but lacks the satisfying chevron encoding.

46301.name: SmartBed
46301.describe: The "window" is just a screen with a looping video. The factory default setting is a scenic view of Glitch City.

46302.name: Passage Gate
46302.describe: Opens when you shoot energy beams at it. Or when you enter the passcode, if you're a boring person.

46303.name: Heart Display
46303.describe: Nothing says "I love you" like a pixel heart. Well, other than "I love you" with spoken words.

46304.name: Vent Cover
46304.describe: A favorite sneaking entrance for cyborgs and snakes alike.

46305.name: Graffiti Wall
46305.describe: A graffiti wall with "Kilroy was here" nowhere to be seen? Kids these days...

47001.name: Big League Floorboards
47001.describe: Let your sweat fall upon the field of youth and glory!

47002.name: Blue Textured Wall
47002.describe: Turn your room into your own hall of fame!

47101.name: Snack Booth
47101.describe: The perfect place to stock up for the long game ahead!

47102.name: Star-Spangled Bed
47102.describe: HOOOOME RUUUN!! Oh... It was just a dream...

47103.name: Burger Beanie Bed
47103.describe: Unexpectedly comfortable... if it doesn't make you hungry.

47104.name: Baseball Stool
47104.describe: A small stool with a baseball design.

47105.name: Baseball Carpet
47105.describe: Much softer than the real thing.

47107.name: Commemorative Display Shelves
47107.describe: Ahh, reminds me of that one game, bases loaded, bottom of the 9th.

47108.name: Bedside Drawers
47108.describe: A rustic wooden drawer that reminds you of old times.

47109.name: Baseball Bat Stand
47109.describe: Contains rare, storied items collected over many years.

47110.name: Manjuu Pitcher
47110.describe: The next one... is going to be a curveball!

47111.name: Manjuu Batter
47111.describe: Watch this... I'm going to hit this out of the ball park!

47112.name: Manjuu Catcher
47112.describe: There's nothing I can't catch... Peep!

47113.name: Potted Plant
47113.describe: Just a friendly reminder that we're still at home. Don't play baseball inside!

47114.name: Baseball Sofa
47114.describe: This sofa was designed to house your rear during game day.

47115.name: Legendary Statue
47115.describe: The history behind this sport is lengthy and glorious!

47116.name: Computer Desk
47116.describe: Don't be fooled - we're studying our opponent's strategy!

47117.name: Cola Tub
47117.describe: Even more refreshing than drinking than real thing!

47118.name: Cardboard Boxes
47118.describe: These are different from the cardboard boxes you were first given. These were used to store baseball equipment!

47119.name: Round Wooden Table
47119.describe: A rough-looking table. Wait, isn't this basically a tree stump?

47120.name: Batting Cage
47120.describe: Let's dial this up to 120 mph! Wait, on second thought...

47201.name: Popcorn
47201.describe: One of the superfan's best friends. Hot Dog couldn't make it though.

47202.name: Baseball Desk Lamp
47202.describe: A baseball-like stitching can be seen around the lamp shade.

47203.name: Green Apple Slushie
47203.describe: Sweet and refreshing with a touch of tartness.

47204.name: Watermelon Slushie
47204.describe: Perfect for a hot summer day.

47205.name: Orange Slushie
47205.describe: A classic favorite, now on ice.

47207.name: Snack Sampler
47207.describe: Don't fight, there's plenty to go around for everyone!

47301.name: Scoreboard
47301.describe: It's been repurposed to keep track of days of the week instead of innings.

47302.name: Baseball Window
47302.describe: The ball game is going on just outside!

47303.name: Baseball Television
47303.describe: It has more than one channel! I just don't feel like watching anything else...

47304.name: Commemorative Frame
47304.describe: Safeguards a legendary pitcher's jersey. This number has since been retired.

47305.name: Break Room Door
47305.describe: Is this where the athletes go to rest up?

47307.name: Baseball Picture Frames
47307.describe: Each picture contains vivid memories of a sweat-filled youth!

48001.name: Sardegnian Stone Flooring
48001.describe: This stone pavement could face a volcanic eruption and still come out intact. But let's not put that to the test.

48002.name: Sardegnian City Wallpaper
48002.describe: Just like how you might get lost in the city, you might get lost in this wallpaper.

48101.name: Floating City Rainbow
48101.describe: A striking natural phenomenon composed of all colors! All on the spectrum of light visible to the human eye, anyway.

48102.name: Plaza Pigeon
48102.describe: Feed at your own risk. Once they develop a taste for breadcrumbs...

48103.name: Flower Petal Pile
48103.describe: It might be a mess someone has to sweep up later, but it is a pretty mess.

48104.name: Flower Bed (Large)
48104.describe: You know the rent in the neighborhood will be lavishly high when these decorate the streets.

48105.name: Flower Bed
48105.describe: "Mamma mia, that housing bubble is-a coming..."

48106.name: Landscape Oil Painting
48106.describe: The stuff on the canvas is nice and all, but those blotches belong in a modern art museum.

48107.name: Manhole Cover
48107.describe: Local legends speak of folks falling into it and ending up in a place called "1-2."

48108.name: Sardegnian Streetlight
48108.describe: In keeping with the spirit of Romanticism, these streetlights are gas-powered.

48109.name: Bulletin Board
48109.describe: Once a signboard for locals, now it lists nothing but tourist information.

48110.name: Pizza Restaurant Sign 1
48110.describe: "Come get a taste of authentic Sardegnian pizza!"

48111.name: Pizza Restaurant Sign 2
48111.describe: When your eyes catch the sight of a big pizza pie, that's amore.

48112.name: Buffet Sign
48112.describe: Big buffet buffs 'bout to bunch up, begging to buy bountiful brunch.

48113.name: Pizza Restaurant
48113.describe: You didn't come all the way to the Sardegna Empire to NOT buy pizza, did you?

48114.name: Sardegnian Stone Bridge
48114.describe: It's enchanted with a very peculiar spell that causes tourists to drop whatever they're doing to take a selfie on it.

48115.name: Sardegnian Manjuu Fountain
48115.describe: Drop a coin in it and make a wish. It'll either come true or you'll be 1 coin poorer than before.

48116.name: Potted Tree
48116.describe: Imagine being this tree and getting to bask in the city's scenery all day.

48117.name: Black Guard Rail
48117.describe: You can think of them as traffic barriers for gondolas.

48118.name: Patio Chair
48118.describe: Have a seat, take a sip from a glass of wine, recite foreign poetry, and experience il romanticismo della città.

48119.name: Patio Table
48119.describe: Catch a glimpse of your partner, part your lips to form a smile, and savor tua pasta napoletana.

48120.name: Red Bench
48120.describe: "Red is the color of love. Incidentally, care to sit down, signora?"

48121.name: Upright Tower of Pisa
48121.describe: A replica of a famous tower. This time the architects got the foundation right.

48122.name: City Canal
48122.describe: The crown jewel of city aesthetics, radiating the very essence of romanticism. Gondola included!

48201.name: Sardegnian Wine
48201.describe: Iron Blood may have their engineering, but Sardegnian wine is the best in the world.

48202.name: Wine Glass
48202.describe: "With which *normal* people drink wine. Looking at you, Laffey."

48203.name: Sardegnian Spaghetti
48203.describe: Whatever you do, don't drop it.

48301.name: Red Brick Balcony
48301.describe: "See how she leans her cheek upon her hand. O that I were a glove upon that hand, that I might touch that cheek!"

48302.name: Restaurant Service Window
48302.describe: Essentially a low-tech drive-thru for people.

48303.name: Condominium Windows
48303.describe: The windows contribute to a picturesque view, both from outside and inside the building.

49001.name: New Office Flooring
49001.describe: Sometimes, simplicity really is the best.

49002.name: New Office Wallpaper
49002.describe: Please don't be too upset if your furniture doesn't align perfectly with the pattern.

49101.name: Stairway to the Vault
49101.describe: Sounds cool, but the vault mostly just contains old naval documents.

49102.name: Decorative Potted Plant
49102.describe: A plant resembling a palm tree, native to Aruba, Jamaica, ooh I wanna take ya.

49103.name: Large Royal Table
49103.describe: It's so well-polished that it feels like a crime to even place your hand on it.

49104.name: Large Reception Sofa
49104.describe: Seats two people. Has other uses once reception time ends for the day...

49105.name: Small Reception Sofa
49105.describe: Seats one person. Some people would just rather sit alone.

49106.name: Small Royal Table
49106.describe: Very similar to the Large Royal Table. For no particular reason whatsoever, Ark Royal seems to like this one more.

49107.name: Manjuu Orchestra
49107.describe: They have a friendly rivalry with Bismarck's orchestra. Much harder to redeploy though, owing to the piano.

49108.name: Simple Shoe Rack
49108.describe: Is that a super rare Cat Box? Oh... there's only a pair of dress shoes inside.

49109.name: Cupboard with Roses
49109.describe: At least one of the roses is stolen every week. Whoever finds the perpetrator will be handsomely rewarded.

49110.name: Manjuu Butler
49110.describe: A very attentive butler by the name of Sebastian. Please don't lock him up in the Canteen's freezer!

49111.name: Manjuu Maid
49111.describe: Don't mistake her expression for dissatisfaction. She's very much glad to not be stuck working at a maid café.

49112.name: Minigolf Course
49112.describe: Putting it nicely, the salesman's pitch was that it's "par for the course" to have this in the office.

49113.name: Manjuu Gardener
49113.describe: This Manjuu used to work in a clock tower before switching jobs. Looks intimidating, but is just misunderstood.

49114.name: Cabinet with Photograph
49114.describe: It's a bit hard to tell who the photograph is of from the sprite, but Taihou seems keenly interested in finding out.

49115.name: Cabinet with Mirror
49115.describe: "Could we move it? 'Mirror, mirror on the cabinet' doesn't quite have the same ring to it."

49116.name: New Office Desk
49116.describe: Many documents, operation drafts, and love letters find their way to this elegant desk.

49117.name: New Office Chair
49117.describe: Surprisingly plain and disturbingly uncomfortable, considering who usually sits here.

49118.name: Elegant Lamp
49118.describe: Seems to attract many lamp-starved moths.

49119.name: Royal Tea Set
49119.describe: The new Royal Navy carrier who recently joined the fleet insisted on having one in the office. It's so very hard to say no to her...

49120.name: Scholar's Bookshelves
49120.describe: There's no secret chamber located behind these. That would be too obvious.

49121.name: Emblematic Carpet
49121.describe: Represents something grand. You would feel bad stepping on it if it wasn't a carpet, and that's the point.

49122.name: New Office Carpet
49122.describe: Vaguely resembles a runway, which has led to a few incidents with carriers practicing aircraft takeoffs with it.

49302.name: Wall-Mounted Candle
49302.describe: Rustic during the day, spooky at night. Always a fire hazard.

49303.name: Otherworldly Atlas
49303.describe: A map of a markedly different, yet strangely familiar world. Nobody knows where it came from.

49304.name: Grandfather Clock
49304.describe: Doesn't work anymore after Formidable fiddled with it. Still right twice a day, though!

49305.name: New Office Doorway
49305.describe: Walking through something this sumptuous feels like logging into a video game.

50001.name: Eagle Union Drylands
50001.describe: A scenic place, although the sand is coarse, rough, irritating, and gets everywhere.

50002.name: Eagle Union Countryside
50002.describe: For when you want your room to feel a bit more barren.

50101.name: Manjuu Service Area
50101.describe: I heard they don't serve chicken at this establishment.

50102.name: Tumbleweed
50102.describe: Always ready to roll by when your joke doesn't land.

50103.name: Gas Pump
50103.describe: There is an old proverb that goes, "to step on the gas, you must first pump the gas."

50104.name: Vending Machine
50104.describe: A bit top-heavy, so don't kick it. Wouldn't want your post-mortem to read "death by vending machine."

50105.name: Railroad Crossing
50105.describe: Try to cross when the barrier is down and the train will cross you.

50106.name: Eagle Union Road
50106.describe: These roads take you home to the place you belong.

50107.name: Speed Limit Sign
50107.describe: To stop people from starting arguments about it, no unit of speed has been specified.

50108.name: Route Sign
50108.describe: Follow this sign for the one and only way to get your kicks.

50109.name: Directional Sign
50109.describe: As vague as it gets, but still technically correct.

50110.name: A Number of Signs
50110.describe: Feeling lost? These won't help you much, then.

50111.name: Manjuu Road Worker
50111.describe: These little guys really need to unionize...

50112.name: Parking Sign
50112.describe: Some say the sign bears a strong resemblance to a famous idol manager. Others don't see it.

50115.name: Spry Tree
50115.describe: Or maybe this tree just hogged all the water to itself.

50116.name: Cactus
50116.describe: Don't be a stranger, it just wants a hug.

50117.name: Drylands Pond
50117.describe: You can lead a ship girl to water, but can you make her swim?

50118.name: Parking Area
50118.describe: A place to let your ride rest after a long day of engine revving.

50119.name: Chain-link Fence
50119.describe: I have bad news for you. This one's a repost.

50120.name: Traffic Barrier
50120.describe: Remember: road safety is number one! ... But sweet wheelies on your ride are a close second.

50121.name: Windproof Tent
50121.describe: Let's turn this road trip into a camping trip!

50122.name: Hotdog Sign
50122.describe: An enticing sign that attracts equal parts customers, equal parts wild animals that mistake it for the real deal.

50123.name: Traffic Cone
50123.describe: Can also be used as a pointy hat.

50124.name: Downhill Road
50124.describe: A popular haunt for speedsters, and by extension, cops.

51001.name: Concrete Flooring
51001.describe: In retrospect, you realize that concrete may not be the best material for your dormitory's floor.

51002.name: Skyline Wallpaper
51002.describe: A picturesque view of a city that lives in the year 207X A.D.

51101.name: Manjuu Teahouse
51101.describe: "One cup of matcha and one cup of Darjeeling? Absolu-tea. Coming right up!"

51103.name: Mega Manjuu Lantern
51103.describe: 2,000 HP. Summons smaller lanterns as adds.

51104.name: Red Brick Building
51104.describe: Ye Olde Brickwork Restaurant. Est 10 years ago.

51105.name: Row of Lanterns
51105.describe: They don't drop hearts or items, so don't even think about breaking them.

51106.name: Market Signage
51106.describe: You don't need directions to find delicious food in this part of town.

51107.name: Market Archway
51107.describe: As you walk through it, you feel as though you've entered a world of epicurism.

51108.name: Boba Tea: New & Improved Recipe
51108.describe: Word is they're trying to trademark that phrase.

51109.name: Market Billboard 1
51109.describe: 4 PM: Gluttony Hour, 50% off at all restaurants.

51110.name: Market Billboard 2
51110.describe: 6:15 PM: Float Festival starts. Bring your own gravity.

51111.name: Market Stone Path
51111.describe: You never thought rock could be so smooth. And slippery, after rain.

51113.name: Market Stone Border
51113.describe: Garnished with greenery to break up the mono-stony.

51114.name: Hot Dog Stand
51114.describe: Here's your once-in-a-year chance to try some very novel hot dog toppings.

51115.name: Milky Boba Tea Stand
51115.describe: We're milking this trend for all it's worth.

51116.name: Pizza Stand
51116.describe: You'll want to be quick. They're usually sold out by the early evening.

51117.name: Rainbow Tower
51117.describe: Indeed, the interior matches the exterior.

51118.name: Stone Seat
51118.describe: A stone-age design brought into the 21st century.

52001.name: Halloween Flooring
52001.describe: Has been carefully maintained for generations, hence its pristi- wait... "flooring"?

52002.name: Halloween Wallpaper
52002.describe: Gives your room that "perpetually stuck in the twilight zone" feel.

52101.name: Halloween Tower
52101.describe: One stairway leads up, the other to a dungeon of certain doom. If only you had a helmet torch to light the way.

52102.name: Treat Street Cart
52102.describe: Sorry, trick-or-treaters: they don't give out candy for free here.

52103.name: Trick Street Cart
52103.describe: Didn't come up with any tricks to pull? Never fear, the Trick Cart is here!

52104.name: Manjuu Nurse Team
52104.describe: Here in case of a medical emergency, or just celebrating the holiday? Who knows!

52106.name: Bat Carpet
52106.describe: No unauthorized battery on these premises, you hear?

52107.name: Pile-o'-Pumpkins
52107.describe: Could that be the famed Great Pumpkin?

52108.name: Jiangjuu
52108.describe: A distant relative of that counting vampire. This one, however, has a penchant for hopscotch.

52109.name: Manboo
52109.describe: This Manjuu hasn't had much luck this Halloween. It's gotten nothing but rocks.

52110.name: Frankenjuu
52110.describe: Will enter a spell-bound berserk if commanded to by its master.

52111.name: Buried Manjuu
52111.describe: It's okay, the Manjuu is just literally resting in peace. Once naptime is over, it'll get up.

52112.name: Spooky Barrel
52112.describe: What scary surprises does it hide? The suspense is un-barrel-able!

52113.name: Dead Tree
52113.describe: It's kind of distasteful, really. Like dressing a corpse in a suit. Admittedly, that fits the season...

52114.name: Seasonal Tree
52114.describe: Gosh, they put out these Christmas decorations sooner and sooner with each passing year...

52115.name: Drinks Stall
52115.describe: Rumor has it the drinks are brewn by a witch with a strong dislike of birds and bears.

52116.name: Pumpkin Vendor Manjuu
52116.describe: "Manjuu has wares, if you have coin."

52117.name: Giant Candy Pumpkin
52117.describe: Full of diabetes-inducing, obesity-causing goodies. Enjoy in moderation.

52118.name: Halloween Barricade
52118.describe: Mostly keeps the real monsters out. Mostly.

52119.name: Halloween Limousine
52119.describe: Takes you on a ride... TO HELL! Sorry, "heck."

52120.name: Halloween Projector
52120.describe: Ready for a fright? It's movie night.

53001.name: Backstage Room Flooring
53001.describe: Polished and waxed like a luxury car.

53002.name: Backstage Room Wallpaper
53002.describe: You'll know you've made it big when your aesthetic is black and gold.

53101.name: Bathtruck
53101.describe: Combine your promo tour and swimsuit photoshoot into one!

53102.name: Backstage Carpet
53102.describe: Have a small taste of the proverbial red carpet before hitting the stage.

53103.name: Blue Star Tile
53103.describe: Get your game on, go play.

53104.name: Yellow Star Tile
53104.describe: Get the show on, get paid.

53105.name: Passionate Drumkit
53105.describe: Any song can be improved with a drumbeat.

53106.name: Costume Rack
53106.describe: Certain shipgirls are already intimately familiar with another type of rack.

53107.name: Passionate Keyboard
53107.describe: This particular one was formerly owned by a notorious rich girl with thick eyebrows.

53108.name: Flashy Staircase
53108.describe: Takes you to the next stage. Literally.

53110.name: Concert Signboard
53110.describe: Featuring a Manjuu rocking a look from a bygone era, when the drinks were cheap and the skirts were long.

53111.name: Autograph Table
53111.describe: "If they're called autographs, why don't they write themselves? Laffey's tired..."

53112.name: Backstage Dresser
53112.describe: Putting on a good show is only one half of the fight. Putting on good makeup is the other.

53113.name: Platform Staircase
53113.describe: I hope you're not afraid of heights, 'cause we're going up high into stardom.

53114.name: Manjuu Dance Stage
53114.describe: Get someone up there and watch them dance like a lunatic.

53115.name: Passionate Loudspeaker
53115.describe: It'll turn your performance up to 11. Just mind the feedback.

53119.name: Line Barrier
53119.describe: Stop the crowd from going *too* wild.

53116.name: Backstage Mirror
53116.describe: "Mirror, mirror to my right, who's gonna be rocking the stage tonight?"

53117.name: Manjuu Glowstick Waver
53117.describe: There's a whole lot more to the job than just waving a glowstick around. According to this Manjuu, anyway.

53301.name: Decorative Light Sign
53301.describe: Ex-Crimson Axis ships look at it with slight envy in their eyes.

53303.name: Backstage Door
53303.describe: Stationed outside: hundreds of clamoring fans.

53304.name: Retro Manjuu Display
53304.describe: Retro, or just really bad PPI? Depends on your perspective.

54104.name: Strawberry Sticks
54104.describe: Lighting has never been so strawberry-licious!

55001.name: Holoflooring
55001.describe: Reminiscent of the pattern found in Hololive's office.

55002.name: Holowallpaper
55002.describe: Has an authentic Hololive feeling to it.

55101.name: Holoboard
55101.describe: Covered in personalized Hololive stickers and drawings.

55102.name: Aqua's Bed
55102.describe: "Even without work to do, I get tired just lying down all day!"

55103.name: Holohighdef TV
55103.describe: An ultra-widescreen television. Highly appraised as a home theater.

55104.name: Magic Carpet
55104.describe: A magic carpet that Shion owns.

55105.name: Magic Closet
55105.describe: A magic closet that Shion owns. Whatever someone imagined would come out does when they open it.

55106.name: Holonight Table
55106.describe: A night table made of wood. It makes you feel real cozy.

55107.name: Holodisplay Case
55107.describe: A glass case for displaying things. Exactly what it says on the tin.

55108.name: Sunflowers
55108.describe: Floriographically, sunflowers symbolize adoration, sincerity, and quiet love. Remember to water it and give it sunlight.

55109.name: Pair of Balloons
55109.describe: A pair of balloons that serve as indoor decorations.

55110.name: Triangular Swim Ring
55110.describe: A swim ring, designed by a certain magician to be triangular.

55111.name: Sky Blue Sofa
55111.describe: Comes with three pillows, one which looks like the sun, two which look like stars.

55112.name: D20 Chair
55112.describe: Pick your favorite number and roll the dice.

55113.name: Duel Device
55113.describe: The symbol of an evil game... Never, ever touch it! Ever!

55115.name: Hologamer Chair
55115.describe: Remarkably comfortable. Everybody wants one of their own.

55116.name: Marine Maid's Battlestation
55116.describe: A gaming desk with associated hardware. Maid Inside (trademark.)

55117.name: Holodressing Table
55117.describe: A table where you can put on makeup and store your personal trinkets.

55118.name: Holostage
55118.describe: A massive Hololive stage for idols to shine their brightest on!

55120.name: Holoaquarium
55120.describe: An aquarium with a Hololive theme. Putting the fish aside, there seems to be... something else in there?

55121.name: Indoor Ocean
55121.describe: Enjoy the beach at any time of the year from the comfort of your room!

55201.name: Magic Thermos
55201.describe: Remember to drink plenty of water.

55202.name: (Nakiri's) Sword Rack
55202.describe: This is where she keeps Rakshasa and Asura.

55203.name: Bermbew Sprawt
55203.describe: A plushie of a... creature(?) that hangs around Shirakami Fubuki.

55205.name: Onion & Fish Paste Soup
55205.describe: A freshly made hot bowl of soup. It tastes great, I tell ya!

55206.name: Ookami Mio Plushie
55206.describe: A wolfy plushie of Ookami Mio.

55207.name: Nakiri Ayame Plushie
55207.describe: A devilish plushie of Nakiri Ayame.

55208.name: Murasaki Shion Plushie
55208.describe: A magic plushie of Murasaki Shion.

55209.name: Minato Aqua Plushie
55209.describe: A marine plushie of Minato Aqua.

55210.name: Natsuiro Matsuri Plushie
55210.describe: A peppy plushie of Natsuiro Matsuri.

55211.name: Shirakami Fubuki Plushie
55211.describe: A foxy plushie of Shirakami Fubuki.

55212.name: Tokino Sora Plushie
55212.describe: An airy plushie of Tokino Sora.

55214.name: Corn Cushion
55214.describe: Corn on the cush. Is there something hiding behind it?

55301.name: Marine Decorations
55301.describe: Starfish, the sea, shells, and corals. All the aquatic essence you could want.

55302.name: Triangular Pennant
55302.describe: Sadly not a tricolor for the double triple. Nor tricornes for the triple triple.

55303.name: Marine Curtains
55303.describe: A set of curtains the Marine Maid loves above all else.

55305.name: Wall-Mounted Spirit Painting
55305.describe: A painting of Nakiri Ayame's friendly spirits, Karma and Shiranui.
