55306.name: Spruce Sticker
55306.describe: Put some of these up for a foresty feel indoors!

55307.name: Holobookcase
55307.describe: A bookcase that houses books, bonsai, and all sorts of other things.

56001.name: Fairytale Town Floor Tiles
56001.describe: A rustic, snowy brick street. Stay outside too long and you might hear yourself saying "Bah, humbug!"

56002.name: Fairytale Town Wallpaper
56002.describe: Tonight, Santa Claus is coming to town~

56101.name: Fantasy Trolley
56101.describe: It is said to sweep you away on a magical journey for the price of just one cent, nya.

56102.name: Fairytale Town Lamppost
56102.describe: It radiates a warm, mesmerizing light across the snow.

56103.name: Santa Snow-juu
56103.describe: This frosty snow-juu is really feeling the holiday spirit.

56104.name: Christmas Billboard
56104.describe: Don't forget to log in daily and complete your special missions!

56105.name: Fruity Lollipop Display
56105.describe: Don't lick it though, that'd be unsanitary.

56106.name: Peppermint Lollipop Display
56106.describe: Doubles as a car freshener after the holiday season.

56107.name: Fairytale Town Tree
56107.describe: Though its leaves have fallen, it bears golden fruit tonight.

56108.name: Fairytale Christmas Tree
56108.describe: This symbol of peace brings everyone together. Or maybe they're just here for presents...

56109.name: Fairytale Clock Tower
56109.describe: Not so big anymore are you, Ben?

56110.name: Fairytale Cabin
56110.describe: Someone tell this Manjuu that you have to be asleep for Santa to visit.

56111.name: Christmas Confectionary
56111.describe: Free hot chocolate for everyone on this chilly evening.

56112.name: Patch of Snow
56112.describe: Use it to manifest your dreams into reality, until the next morning.

56113.name: Fairytale Town Fence
56113.describe: Despite its normal purpose, it currently looks like several friends joining hands.

56114.name: Fairytale Town Windmill
56114.describe: Jousting with it would be positively quixotic.

56115.name: Fairytale Snowglobe
56115.describe: A dreamlike world swirls inside this snowglobe.

57002.name: Nighttime Fuji Wallpaper
57002.describe: Named after its designer, not the mountain. Or the company called that. Or the other one also called that.

57101.name: Shrine Lanterns
57101.describe: "It is at this time of year when something extraordinary happens: the lanterns flock to one location, then fly off to find a mate."

57102.name: Shrine Footpath Decoration
57102.describe: Only ever seems to light up with blue flames.

57103.name: Manjuu Household Shrine
57103.describe: Pray to the Manjuu, and the Manjuu shall give. Sooner or later.

57104.name: Shrine Footpath
57104.describe: Walk the path. BE the path. Follow it, but in your own way.

57105.name: Auspicious Pine Decoration
57105.describe: With any luck, that clumsy maid won't knock it over while you're out.

57106.name: Shrine Torii
57106.describe: Remember to perform the ceremonial rites before proceeding beyond its stone visage.

57107.name: New Year's Bulletin Board
57107.describe: Has tons of useful, albeit very awkwardly translated tourist information.

57108.name: Black Temari
57108.describe: Surprisingly lethal when thrown at high speeds.

57109.name: Red Temari
57109.describe: Dyed red with the blood of its victims.

57110.name: Colorful Temari
57110.describe: Just a pretty ball for children to play with. Nothing treacherous about it.

57111.name: Manjuu Pagoda
57111.describe: Fancy on the outside but empty on the inside. Don't be like this pagoda, kids.

57112.name: Huge Dango
57112.describe: A new year's staple blown up to ridiculous proportions. Hope you're hungry.

57113.name: Glazed Dango
57113.describe: Vaguely like a marshmallow covered in chocolate syrup.

57114.name: Open-Air Hot Spring
57114.describe: It's either this or a beach episode while the plot catches up.

57115.name: Manjuu Fortune Table
57115.describe: These yearly fortunes used to be decided randomly, but nowadays you can pay for good luck. Thanks, capitalism.

57116.name: Takoyaki Stand
57116.describe: Get 'em while they're hot, but wait until they've cooled before you chow down.

57117.name: Manjuu Takoyaki
57117.describe: Just to clarify: these are made BY a Manjuu, not FROM one.

57118.name: Massive Shrine Bell
57118.describe: "Apparently it's inappropriate when I say it, while this thing can go 'DOOOOONG!' all it wants."

57120.name: Kamininaru Gate
57120.describe: Has an inscription at its base that reads "MINNADESHINDEKAMININARU," whatever that means.

58001.name: Spring Reunion Floor
58001.describe: It's rocky and has lots of cracks... like a lot of family reunions.

58002.name: Spring Reunion Wallpaper
58002.describe: A beautiful, festive red. Hides bloodstains well.

58102.name: Festive Lanterns
58102.describe: A festive way to light up your night.

58103.name: Spring Reunion Feast
58103.describe: I'm just here for the free food, peep...

58104.name: Empery Zither
58104.describe: Time to drop some sick beats.

58105.name: Model Terrace
58105.describe: It just isn't the Dragon Empery without mountains and flowing water. Even indoors.

58106.name: Lucky Kumquat Plant
58106.describe: Golden and sweet, just like money.

58107.name: Spring Reunion Liquor
58107.describe: Gets better the longer it's been sitting in the cellar. Just like your obnoxious relatives.

58108.name: Mochi Manjuu
58108.describe: Rice won't become mochi unless you beat it!

58109.name: Porcelain Plate
58109.describe: A beautiful piece of art from the Dragon Empery.

58111.name: Manjuu Statue
58111.describe: The least intimidating stone sentinel you'll ever see.

58113.name: Open-Air Bath
58113.describe: Phew... Wash away the old, in with the new!

58114.name: Dragon Dancers
58114.describe: It takes some serious talent to do this with those stubby Manjuu arms.

58115.name: Lion Dancers
58115.describe: Doesn't it get hot under there?

58116.name: Spring Festival Food Stall
58116.describe: Piping hot food, coming right up!

58302.name: Lucky Sign
58302.describe: The spring breeze brings in another auspicious year!

58303.name: Spring Festival Gate
58303.describe: A grand entrance to a grand festival.

58304.name: Spring Festival Yard
58304.describe: An ear-splitting start to the New Year awaits you outside.

59001.name: Dreamy Flooring
59001.describe: It might be tempting to lick it, but trust me, it's not strawberry-flavored. Or sanitary.

59002.name: Dreamy Wallpaper
59002.describe: Mixing some pain and some passion, nothing is ever enough. Except the amount of pink in this room.

59101.name: Sugary Sweet Fridge
59101.describe: Oh baby you should go and love yourself. And this fridge has everything you need to do just that.

59102.name: Dreamy Double Bed
59102.describe: Look, we said love nest but apparently the Manjuu only heard the "nest" part.

59103.name: Creamsichair
59103.describe: Sitting on this chair, I told you everything.

59104.name: Sugary Sweet Nightstand
59104.describe: I'd like one sugary sweet night stand.

59105.name: Oversized Bean Bag Manjuu
59105.describe: We could let our friends crash in the living room. This is our place, but they can have this Manjuu cushion.

59106.name: Sugary Sweet Staircase
59106.describe: This doesn't actually lead anywhere. It's just a metaphor for life and love.

59107.name: Heart-shaped Rose Garden
59107.describe: Cute and endearing on the outside, a huge thorn in the side where people can't see.

59108.name: Dreamy Balloons
59108.describe: Sometimes they fly away, sometimes they deflate. But, enjoy them to the fullest while they last.

59109.name: Aeroplane Chess
59109.describe: Why is this here? Are we trying to celebrate relationships or break them?

59110.name: Sugary Sweet Wardrobe
59110.describe: Cause there's nothing like this feeling, now that I found out that my old clothes don't fit me anymore.

59111.name: Manjuu Beanie Chair
59111.describe: Nooo, don't sit on its face, it's not into that!

59112.name: Sugary Sweet Bathtub
59112.describe: It's actually a completely ordinary bathtub except with a cute towel draped over it. Look, it doesn't make the water sweet either.

59113.name: Sugary Sweet Workstation
59113.describe: Show of hands, who here actually works more efficiently in the presence of their significant other?

59114.name: Romantic Dining Table
59114.describe: Treat your favorite shipgirl to a romantic candlelit dinner.

59115.name: Box of Rings
59115.describe: Wait, you're supposed to give these to people, not collect them.

59116.name: Sugary Sweet Carousel
59116.describe: The Manjuu seems to be letting out a battlecry of "yooooo, pon!" What could it mean though?

59117.name: Pavilion of Love
59117.describe: It's said that making a vow underneath this pavilion grants eternal blessings.

59301.name: Heart-themed Wall Storage
59301.describe: Full of holes, and easily filled with worldly possessions.

59302.name: Sugar Sweet Balcony
59302.describe: Part the veil, for it is a lovely day outside.

59303.name: LOVE Shelves
59303.describe: Don't you LOVE sensible, modern storage solutions? No?

60001.name: Penitentiary Flooring
60001.describe: Pros: cools your feet during summer. Cons: gives you frostbite during winter.

60002.name: Penitentiary Wallpaper
60002.describe: Not much to look at, but requires practically no maintenance.

60101.name: Frozen Manjuu
60101.describe: It might be cold in here, but at least you're not this Manjuu.

60103.name: Penitentiary Bed
60103.describe: It's very comfy for a penitentiary bed. Also much better than sleeping on the floor.

60104.name: Penitentiary Chair
60104.describe: An all-purpose chair, albeit without a backrest. Maybe not so all-purpose.

60105.name: Storage Room Staircase
60105.describe: We're sorry to disappoint if you were expecting it to lead to a dank dungeon.

60106.name: Penitentiary Radiator
60106.describe: Many take heating for granted until their fellow inmates start hogging this thing.

60107.name: Brown Carpet
60107.describe: It looks alluring, but is just as cold as everything else here.

60108.name: Branding Iron Pot
60108.describe: What are they for? Let's just say... roasting marshmallows.

60109.name: Restrained Manjuu
60109.describe: Some prefer calling it rehabilitation rather than punishment.

60110.name: Bartender Manjuu
60110.describe: "Got some spirits that oughta warm ya up, pal."

60111.name: Liquor Shelf
60111.describe: "Sub-15% ABV? Might as well be drinking water."

60112.name: Cell Door
60112.describe: Relax, they won't lock you up and throw away the key. Keys cost money.

60114.name: Manjuu Washlet
60114.describe: No toilet paper; that's what the bidet is for.

60115.name: Warning Sign
60115.describe: If you like your tongue where it is, you should probably heed the warning.

60116.name: Warden's Desk
60116.describe: Where an eccentric individual in a purple suit used to sit before they fired him.

60117.name: Cell Bars
60117.describe: Not as handy as handlebars nor as tasty as chocolate bars.

60119.name: Vodka Bath
60119.describe: This is what happens when you ask for a shot and don't specify how big.

60122.name: Questioning Chair
60122.describe: It's like an intense massage chair once you get used to it.

60123.name: Penitentiary Workbench
60123.describe: "Work" and "bench" might be embellishing it a bit.

60124.name: Manjuu Guard
60124.describe: Makes sure all the inmates behave, a job which this Manjuu seems to love.

60118.name: Penitentiary Pool Table
60118.describe: Do as you're told and you'll get to play a round or two.

60120.name: Digging Manjuu
60120.describe: Is it digging an escape hole, or its own grave? Only time will tell.

60301.name: Penitentiary Signboard
60301.describe: Has info on all the latest happenings.

60302.name: Penitentiary Leaflets
60302.describe: Has info on all the latest happenings from a few years ago.

60303.name: Penitentiary Window
60303.describe: Looking through it confirms one thing: life on the outside ain't what it used to be.

60304.name: Northern Parliament Photographs
60304.describe: A picture's worth a thousand words. A bear, even more.

60305.name: Snow White Minitable
60305.describe: Not made by a princess, nor covered in snow. It's just an aesthetic choice.

61002.name: Stadium Wallpaper
61002.describe: Clear skies and sunshine. Perfect weather for any kind of sport.

61101.name: Sports Meet Booth
61101.describe: Grab a bottle of water and head on in.

61102.name: Position Marker 1
61102.describe: First up: Shimakaze. She's so fast she finished the race without even attending!

61103.name: Position Marker 2
61103.describe: Second: Tashkent. Though called a "cruiser," she gives even the lightest of cruisers a run for their money!

61104.name: Position Marker 3
61104.describe: Third: Kongou. She's quick, she's elegant, she can sip a cup of tea while she speeds along!

61105.name: Position Marker 4
61105.describe: Fourth: Maury. Also known as Hurricane Maury, she'll leave you in the dust if you don't hurry!

61106.name: Position Marker 5
61106.describe: Fifth: Charles Ausburne. Watch out; when she gets going, she *really* gets going!

61107.name: Referee Tower
61107.describe: "Foul play? Tell it to the judge."

61108.name: Referee Chair
61108.describe: Gets you closer to the action, albeit with a worse view of it.

61110.name: Manjuu Stands
61110.describe: Not particularly packed, but they'll cheer extra loud to make up for it.

61111.name: Tennis Fence
61111.describe: On today's list of satisfying noises: this fence when a ball hits it.

61112.name: Track Hurdle
61112.describe: ♪ It's time to jump up in the air ♪

61113.name: Running Track Carpet
61113.describe: The race track. Where speedruns take place.

61114.name: Tennis Net
61114.describe: If you tore one of these using tennis equipment, would that be racketeering?

61115.name: Manjuu w/ Whistle
61115.describe: This Manjuu's job is to call out and blow the whistle on you.

61116.name: Cherry Blossom Tree
61116.describe: You'll find a few of these around the Academy too.

61117.name: Competition Swimming Pool
61117.describe: It takes a brave soul to compete in this sport against the naturally talented submarines.

61119.name: Obstacle Race Cone
61119.describe: "For the last time, San Diego! Running *over* them gets you *disqualified*!"

61120.name: Camera Manjuu
61120.describe: You wouldn't believe how expensive high-end cameras made for a Manjuu can get.

61121.name: Vending Machine
61121.describe: "Ah, a free bottle at the entrance, then the vending machine charges you for more... That's how they get you."

61123.name: Long Jump Sand Patch
61123.describe: Just don't botch the landing. Or do, if you want to end up in a sports fails compilation.

61124.name: Pole Vault Mat
61124.describe: This will either be the hardest jump or the easiest limbo walk of your life.

61126.name: Batting Manjuu
61126.describe: Watch where you swing or you *will* bat an eye.

61301.name: Seven-Segment Display
61301.describe: Whether you're playing football or soccer, this board's got your scores covered.

61302.name: Basketball Scoreboard
61302.describe: Good to have when you're shooting some b-ball outside of the school.

61303.name: Baseball Scoreboard
61303.describe: Disappointingly, it's not the classic green design.

62001.name: Iris Grass Flooring
62001.describe: A great contributor to the rural aesthetic.

62002.name: Port City Wallpaper
62002.describe: The city is never too far away, but neither is it too near.

62102.name: Pink Lavender
62102.describe: Some Floyd or another named themselves after this color.

62103.name: City Merchant
62103.describe: Sells you fine wares at discount prices. Don't let the missus find out.

62104.name: Two-Story Brick Building
62104.describe: Get a bunch of these, place them at random angles, and you've got yourself some surrealist imagery.

62105.name: Iris Villa
62105.describe: A place to get away from it all.

62106.name: Iris Bread
62106.describe: Eat it quick, before it hardens and becomes legally classified as a blunt weapon.

62107.name: Iris River
62107.describe: The lavender skies are reflected on its clear surface.

62108.name: Flower Petals
62108.describe: Are these the result of bad gardening, or a recent wedding?

62109.name: Iris Flower Bed
62109.describe: If a flower bed is where flowers sleep, where do they go when they're awake?

62110.name: Iris Fence
62110.describe: The flowers are a nice touch, like a cute floral bowtie.

62111.name: Disused White Chapel
62111.describe: "Come. Sit on the pew and join me in prayer."

62112.name: Stone Arch
62112.describe: Perhaps not as famous as the golden double arch, but you can't beat that rustic look.

62115.name: Brick Bath
62115.describe: Get wet like they did in days of yore.

62116.name: Riverside Food Tables
62116.describe: A picturesque moment in the making.

62117.name: Purple Hot Air Balloon
62117.describe: This design was pioneered by the Manjuufier brothers.

62118.name: Iris Windmill
62118.describe: Windmills don't have a word for "love," they just spin and that's beautiful.

63001.name: Pizzeria Flooring
63001.describe: Waxed daily, like a model's back.

63002.name: Pizzeria Wallpaper
63002.describe: Colored to subconsciously make you feel hungry.

63101.name: Pizzeria Circular Table
63101.describe: Now we just need two Sardegnian chefs, two dogs, and some spaghetti with meatballs.

63102.name: Pizzeria Rectangular Table
63102.describe: A table for two is a table for you.

63103.name: Pizza Bed
63103.describe: Now YOU can be the hottest topping!

63104.name: Pizza Cake
63104.describe: You've heard of pizza pie, now get ready for...

63105.name: Pizzeria Fence
63105.describe: A staple of the 21st century fancy restaurant look.

63106.name: Pizzeria Stool
63106.describe: For those that like their seating like their pizzas.

63107.name: Waiter Manjuu
63107.describe: Happy to bring you all the breadsticks you want.

63108.name: Pizza-bringing Manjuu
63108.describe: Those stubby little arms can't be making this job any easier. Leave 'em a tip.

63109.name: Cardboard Cutout Manjuu
63109.describe: A cutout of the famous Scott, president of Manjuuminos Pizza.

63110.name: Pizzeria Sign
63110.describe: "Like what you see? We have the hottest single slices in your area."

63111.name: Broccoli Plant
63111.describe: We're not judging anyone, BUT... surely you don't put broccoli on your pizza?

63112.name: Pizza Chair
63112.describe: Now you can have your Margherita and sit on it too.

63113.name: Pizzeria Couch
63113.describe: How they manage to keep them clean of tomato sauce stains is a trade secret.

63114.name: Pizzeria Counter
63114.describe: If you're just getting takeout, head right here.

63115.name: Topping Bushes 1
63115.describe: Shrimp doesn't grow on trees... but bushes are a different matter.

63116.name: Topping Bushes 2
63116.describe: Pick mushrooms if you want a real one-upper of a pizza.

63301.name: Pizzeria Menu
63301.describe: Most of these names don't tell you much about the pizzas themselves.

63302.name: Kitchen Window Manjuu
63302.describe: Back there, the ovens are always on and the dough is always rising.

63303.name: Pizzeria Blackboard
63303.describe: There's a new funny or endearing message on it every day. Sound familiar?

63304.name: Pizzeria Entrance
63304.describe: It plays a cute little tune when the doors open.

65001.name: Wabi-sabi Flooring
65001.describe: Allow your inner aesthete a moment of appreciation.

65002.name: Wabi-sabi Wallpaper
65002.describe: To lock up such solemn beauty within four walls is almost a crime against the arts.

65101.name: Wabi-sabi Leaf Pile
65101.describe: The question is: to leave them be, or summon the gardener?

65102.name: Tanuki Statue
65102.describe: Want to steal his look? All you need is a big leaf.

65103.name: Welcoming Pine Tree
65103.describe: Some call it the king of this sublime courtyard.

65104.name: Courtyard Bridge
65104.describe: Atop which many a shipgirl have reminisced of their dear commander.

65105.name: Go Set
65105.describe: The Manjuu looks like it wants an opponent to play.

65106.name: Wabi-sabi Stone Patch
65106.describe: Don't let the moss fool you, they are carefully maintained to look this way.

65107.name: Traditional Garden Lantern
65107.describe: When nighttime comes, its glow shall be gorgeous.

65108.name: Small Wayside Shrine
65108.describe: Offer a quick prayer to the gods, then you can be on your way.

65109.name: Traditional Stone Lantern
65109.describe: "To be a lantern – to have bones of stone and a heart that glows – is to be me"

65110.name: Stone Manjuu Statue
65110.describe: A statue of the great Manami Juusaki, who unified the then-warring Manjuu states.

65111.name: Repositionable Lantern
65111.describe: Not all lanterns have to be stationary!

65112.name: Cleansing Water
65112.describe: Purges your hands of bacteria and your heart of sin.

65113.name: Courtyard Porch
65113.describe: Upon the land, the wood. Upon the wood, the cushions. Upon the cushions, you.

65114.name: Wabi-sabi Bush
65114.describe: Is it square, or is it round? Perhaps neither... perhaps both.

65115.name: Wabi-sabi Maple Tree
65115.describe: The pine tree's sweet, syrup-producing mistress watches from afar.

65116.name: Wabi-sabi Plant
65116.describe: What plant even is this? No matter, it's positively wabi-sabi.

65117.name: Courtyard Stepping Stones
65117.describe: Respect the atmosphere and remember they are stepping stones, not skipping stones.

65118.name: Bamboo Fence
65118.describe: The bamboo is always greener on the other side.

65119.name: Courtyard Pond
65119.describe: No fishing or toe-dipping allowed. Fish-dipping, however...

65120.name: Nagashi-Soumen Machine
65120.describe: It's like a noodle water slide. Fun for everyone, the food included!

65301.name: Courtyard Entrance
65301.describe: It's time to return to reality. Don't let the existentialism hit you on the way out.

66002.name: Bleachers Wallpaper
66002.describe: Manjuu-sized. Accommodations are available if you need a larger seat.

66102.name: Race Track Banner
66102.describe: Waves indifferently in the wind. Flutters in shock when cars race by.

66103.name: Road Cone
66103.describe: Run them over to throw off opponents and earn the ire of the organizers.

66104.name: Manjuu Billboard
66104.describe: And now, a word from our sponsors: Manjuu Racing!

66105.name: Speed Bump
66105.describe: "Accursed things. I just want to go fast!"

66106.name: Race Track Railing
66106.describe: The only thing standing between an on-road and an off-road accident.

66107.name: Spectator Platform
66107.describe: These are the seating accommodations. Also the MVP seats.

66108.name: Relay Crew
66108.describe: They handle everything from flag-waving to commentating.

66109.name: Redirection Triangle
66109.describe: A bit more to the left, now!

66110.name: Tire Pile
66110.describe: Are they spare or spent? Better ask the pit crew.

66111.name: Broadcasting Van
66111.describe: Converted from some old mystery machine.

66112.name: Race Track Fence
66112.describe: Keeps the wildlife out and the vehicles in.

66113.name: Track Tree (Summer)
66113.describe: "Would you look at that! Even the trees have come to watch the race!"

66114.name: Track Tree (Autumn)
66114.describe: "Would you look at that! Even the trees have come to watch the race!"

66115.name: Starting Line
66115.describe: Step on the gas just after the second light blinks for a speed boost!

66116.name: Run-Off Area
66116.describe: Grass and asphalt. The oldest rivalry on the race track.

66117.name: Track Indicator 1
66117.describe: Don't listen to it. There's no way but forward.

66118.name: Track Indicator 2
66118.describe: Might be a sign there's treasure buried underneath.

66119.name: Track Indicator 3
66119.describe: Let's just say this points you to the right road.

66120.name: Track Indicator 4
66120.describe: And if not, there's always this road left.

66121.name: Track Indicator 5
66121.describe: That's the spirit! Full speed ahead!

66122.name: Red Blaze
66122.describe: It burns its brightest on streets of fire.

66123.name: White Fang
66123.describe: This speedy speed boy was born to overtake, born to race and to overdrive.

66124.name: Blue Poseidon
66124.describe: It's got crazy locomotion and is jumping with emotion.

66125.name: Orange Manjuu
66125.describe: "Get in. We're gonna have a night of fire."

66126.name: Yellow Stinger
66126.describe: "Deja vu... I swear I've seen this car before."

66127.name: Race Car Exhibition
66127.describe: People come for the race queens but stay for the hot rides.

68001.name: Manjuuversal Studios Floor
68001.describe: Follow the footsteps of the stars!

68002.name: Manjuuversal Studios Wallpaper
68002.describe: Conveniently contains all those rides you swore to never go on.

68101.name: Studios Road Sign
68101.describe: Just because someone stumbles and loses their path, doesn't mean they can't just look at this sign.

68102.name: Studios Palm Tree
68102.describe: All the leaves are green! And the sky is purple!

68103.name: Manjuuversal Studios Entrance
68103.describe: Ms. Hammann, after careful consideration I've decided not to endorse your park.

68105.name: Studio Park Map
68105.describe: The world is not in your books and maps. It's in this one.

68106.name: Manjuu Popcorn Cart
68106.describe: Ever the crowd favorite, now with extra caramel.

68107.name: Studio Street Light
68107.describe: The manjuu on top is there to scare off the other birds.

68108.name: Studio Landmarks Sign
68108.describe: The most iconic landmark for those who get separated from their groups.

68109.name: Manjuu Pirate Cove
68109.describe: Not all treasure is silver and gold, mate.

68110.name: Tour Trolley
68110.describe: Runs more regularly than the public transit in your city.

69001.name: Infirmary Flooring
69001.describe: Clean, like how a perfect health record looks.

69002.name: Infirmary Wallpaper
69002.describe: Sterile, in both meanings of the word.

69101.name: Lobby Seat
69101.describe: It's not the cushiest, but then again, it's not really a cushion.

69103.name: Dental Engine
69103.describe: Everyone's least favorite place to be. Even with the cute Manjuus.

69104.name: Potted Sunflower
69104.describe: Be a patient patient and stare at these flowers for a while.

69105.name: Infirmary Curtains
69105.describe: What happens behind the curtain? Nothing. It's just for privacy's sake.

69106.name: Magazine Rack
69106.describe: De facto redundant after the widespread adoption of smartphones.

69107.name: Manjuu Nurse w/ Syringe
69107.describe: That's just the sedative. You won't feel a thing... afterwards.

69108.name: Medicine Cabinet
69108.describe: You'd need a degree in chemistry just to understand what these labels mean.

69109.name: Operating Table
69109.describe: Fun fact: both military and medical operations take place in a theater.

69110.name: Infirmary Potted Plant
69110.describe: Cook with almost any other ingredient to make a dish that restores all your hearts.

69111.name: Infirmary Sickbed
69111.describe: Long ago, in this very bed, a legend awoke from a coma that lasted 9 years.

69112.name: Model Skeleton
69112.describe: "This is Mr. Bones. Say hi to Mr. Bones, Mutsuki!"

69113.name: Infirmary Reception
69113.describe: "Paging Doctor Rhodes. Doctor Rhodes, please come to the reception."

69114.name: Lobby Chairs
69114.describe: Please sit down and wait for your name to be called.

69115.name: Water Dispenser
69115.describe: It's the purest water you'll ever taste.

69116.name: Anatomical Model
69116.describe: Offers a view of the literal inner workings of the human body.

69117.name: Infirmary Vending Machine
69117.describe: It even dispenses a few over-the-counter medications!

69118.name: X-ray Machine
69118.describe: "Honey, I'm heading into the Roentgen machine" sounds so much cooler.

69119.name: CT Scan Machine
69119.describe: Not recommended for small children or people with metal bees lodged in their brains.

69120.name: Stretcher Cart
69120.describe: For those times when you're losing him and have to get to the ER, quick.

69121.name: Resting Manjuu
69121.describe: "IT'S NOT 'PINING FOR THE FJORDS'! THIS IS AN EX-MANJUU!"

69301.name: Antibacterial Soap
69301.describe: This has been in high demand lately.

69302.name: ICU Door
69302.describe: "Not surprised you see me. I'm a door."

69303.name: Electrocardiograph
69303.describe: A heartbeat is strangely unromantic in a clinical setting.

69304.name: Doctor Credentials
69304.describe: These mean nothing to you, but they add an air of legitimacy.

69305.name: Cardiology Ward Door
69305.describe: Remember the basics of resuscitation: ♪ Ah, ha, ha, ha, stayin' alive ♪

69306.name: Ophthalmology Ward Door
69306.describe: "Up, up, down, down, left, right, left, right... I can't read the rest."

69307.name: Pulmonology Ward Door
69307.describe: Take a deep breath, then exhale. You are now breathing manually.

69308.name: Orthopedics Ward Door
69308.describe: "I hate to be the bearer of bad news, but... there is a skeleton inside you."

69309.name: Neurology Ward Door
69309.describe: "Great Scott! Nurse, there is an entire galaxy within the patient's cranium!"

70001.describe: It sure is spacious in here.
70001.name: Unison Flooring

70002.describe: A starry view for the starry-eyed talent.

71109.describe: It's only a matter of time before they outgrow the pot made to contain them.

72118.describe: May or may not be harboring coconuts.

72120.describe: Don't get any funny ideas now.

72125.describe: First to fall off the platform is a wet noodle!

79108.describe: Remember to keep those bars tight.

79113.describe: Let's check the feed from the last concert.

79116.describe: It's a pain keeping this many records organized.
